Desc_209.en: The needles are extremely powerful and work in mysterious ways; they may be shot upwards to seek enemies on their own, distracting targets as they watch out for needles falling from the sky.
Desc_209.cn: 苍冥即苍天。苍冥奇针用法神奇，威力极大，可向天射出，使木针自行索敌，敌人须时时提防空中悬针落下，往往分心不及。
Desc_209.ru: Иглы чрезвычайно мощны и действуют таинственным образом; они могут выстреливаться вверх, чтобы самостоятельно искать врагов, отвлекая цели, пока они следят за падающими с неба иглами.

Desc_210.en: The dart consists of a bamboo slingshot and a dart that may be shot out swiftly when faced with an enemy.
Desc_210.cn: 将青竹劈成长条，制成弹弓形状，一旦遇敌，便将竹镖迅速弹出，是为青竹镖。
Desc_210.ru: Дротик состоит из бамбуковой рогатки и дротика, который можно быстро выпустить, столкнувшись с врагом.

Desc_211.en: With a divided tip like a forked snake tongue, the rope may stretch at will: a soft whip when unfurled, or only half a palm wide when rolled up.
Desc_211.cn: 蛇舌飞索末梢分叉，好似蛇信，形如绳索，收放自如，展开时有如软鞭，收起后不过半掌大小。
Desc_211.ru: С раздвоенным кончиком, похожим на раздвоенный змеиный язык, веревка может растягиваться по желанию: мягким Кнутом в развернутом виде или шириной всего в половину ладони в свернутом виде.

Desc_212.en: Shaped like a willow catkin, the dart is made up of thin blades that spread out like feathery catkins floating in the air when thrown out, making it hard to avoid.
Desc_212.cn: 飞絮镖乃是形似柳絮的细刃，因掷出时细刃散开，宛如柳絮漫天，难以躲避而得名。
Desc_212.ru: По форме напоминающий ивовую сережку, дротик состоит из тонких лезвий, которые при броске разлетаются в стороны, как перистые сережки, парящие в воздухе, что затрудняет уклонение.

Desc_213.en: Carved from bamboos, the boomerang is shaped like a swallow with a sharp-edged tail, wings and bill, and may return to the original spot after flying in a circle.
Desc_213.cn: 此物以竹木雕成燕形，燕尾、燕翅、燕喙皆能伤人，因被掷出后飞行一圈便可回到手中，故名“燕归来”。
Desc_213.ru: Вырезанный из бамбука бумеранг имеет форму ласточки с острыми краями хвоста, крыльев и клюва и может возвращаться на исходное место после полета по кругу.

Desc_214.en: Interwoven from soft vines, the ropes are tied to ten fingers on one ends, while the other ends are tied to heavy objects that may be thrown out at any moment to bind an enemy like trapping an all-powerful loong.
Desc_214.cn: 困龙索乃是由软木青藤编织而成，末端套于十指之上，前端缀重物，十股一组，可伺机甩出，缠缚敌人，犹如困龙之索。

Desc_215.en: The needle is shaped like a reed flower with barbs at the tip that may severely injure its target and make them bleed nonstop once it pierces the skin. As pure and innocent as snow, it may only be appreciated from afar.
Desc_215.cn: 荻花飞针形如荻花，针尖暗藏机关，一旦击中目标，便可展开其上倒刺，使人如被百创，流血不止，虽有秋荻胜雪之美，却只可远观，不可亵玩。

Desc_216.en: The rope is ingeniously structured and may be concealed inside the sleeve when rolled up. Once unfurled, it stretches to no end, covering the sun and sky while trapping all enemies beneath.
Desc_216.cn: 通天索结构精巧，盘曲时可纳于袖中，展开后索影蔽日，人在其中，只觉此索无始无终，无穷无尽，索长通天，难以逃脱，故以“通天”名之。
Desc_216.ru: Веревка имеет оригинальную структуру и в свернутом виде может быть спрятана внутри рукава. Однажды развернутый, он простирается до бесконечности, закрывая солнце и небо и заманивая в ловушку всех врагов внизу.

Desc_217.en: Made from spirit wood, the coil of thread is hardly noticeable to human eyes and often sealed inside a box. Once triggered, it shoots into one's body, disturbs their True Qi and vital organs until all their energy is exhausted. One may even meet their end if not treated in time.
Desc_217.cn: 含沙射影以灵木为引，乃是一束人眼难以察觉的细丝。此物常收于匣内，以机关发射，入体后先乱真气，后伤肺腑，最后消磨神志，中者若不及时医治，则难以回天。

Desc_218.en: It is said that under the reign of Amitabha Buddha, "beings experience no suffering, only pure ecstasy." Therefore, it is called the Land of Ecstasy. This realm lies ten trillion Buddha domains away from our world. Made from sacred wood, the needle may make one die without any worries as though they had ascended to the Pure Land and would never return.
Desc_218.cn: 传闻无量寿佛治下，“众生无有众苦，但受诸乐”，故曰“极乐”，极乐之地距此世有十万亿佛土之遥。极乐神针以神木制成，可令中者死而无忧，如同心在净土，再不复归。

Desc_219.en: Forged from pig iron, the flute sounds firm and sturdy, but to music experts, it is piercing and screeching to hear for long.
Desc_219.cn: 铁箫乃是以生铁铸成，其声虽如金石铿锵有力，然而精于乐理者却只觉此音伤耳，不堪久听。
Desc_219.ru: Выкованная из чугуна, флейта звучит твердо и добротно, но для знатоков музыки она кажется пронзительной и визгливой, если ее долго слушать.

Desc_220.en: Crafted from hard iron, the solid flute sounds steady and is tough enough to break human bones, even though it is shaped like a music instrument.
Desc_220.cn: 折骨箫音色沉稳，质地坚硬，乃是以钢铁打造而成，其形虽为乐器，其质却能打折人骨。
Desc_220.ru: Изготовленная из твердого железа, твердая флейта звучит ровно и достаточно прочна, чтобы ломать человеческие кости, даже несмотря на то, что по форме она напоминает музыкальный инструмент.

Desc_221.en: The short and thin flute is named after the wolf fang inserted on the lip plate. It has a melancholic sound, often stirring up nostalgic feelings in travelers on the borderlands.
Desc_221.cn: 狼牙短箫箫体短小，管径较细，因吹口镶有狼牙而得名。此箫声音幽咽，常能牵动边旅之思。
Desc_221.ru: Короткая и тонкая флейта названа в честь волчьего клыка, вставленного в губную пластину. У него меланхоличное звучание, часто вызывающее ностальгические чувства у путешественников по пограничным землям.

Desc_222.en: The flute has a clear and penetrating sound like the roar of a loong, loud enough to make the ground tremble while echoing perpetually. A loong head is carved on the flute crown to make it even more awe-inspiring.
Desc_222.cn: 龙首箫音色明亮，穿透力强，吹奏时似有龙吟之声，常能响彻一室，余音久久不绝，箫首刻有龙头，更显得气势十足。

Desc_223.en: Forged from fine metal, the flute emits a hurried and heavy sound that makes one feel agitated and deranged as though the grim reaper were calling for their soul.
Desc_223.cn: 催魂令乃是以上好的金铁打造而成，其声短促、厚重，可令闻者心思焦虑，神智恍惚，如催魂催命，是以得名。
Desc_223.ru: Выкованная из тонкого металла, флейта издает торопливый и тяжелый звук, который заставляет человека чувствовать себя взволнованным и невменяемым, как будто мрачный жнец призывает его душу.

Desc_224.en: The flute is exquisitely made from fine materials and emits a bright sound that may be as low as roaring thunder or as high as a fenghuang's wail—a rare and precious find.
Desc_224.cn: 轻雷选材考究，做工精细，箫声通透明澈，低音如雷声轰鸣，高音似凤凰清啸，乃是不可多得的箫中佳品。
Desc_224.ru: Флейта изысканно изготовлена из высококачественных материалов и издает яркий звук, который может быть низким, как раскат грома, или высоким, как вопль Фэнхуана — редкая и драгоценная находка.

Desc_225.en: "A whale is a sea fish. The big ones are thousands of zhang long, and the small ones are tens of zhang long." The flute has a deep and profound sound, overwhelming and powerful enough to shake the earth as though a gigantic whale were stirring up the sea; only the most experienced adventurer may be able to command it.
Desc_225.cn: “鲸鱼者，海鱼也。大者长千里，小者数十丈”。吞海长鲸音色浑厚，气吞川流，故而以长鲸吞海喻之。其声高亢无比，铺天盖地，非功力深厚者难以驾驭。

Desc_226.en: The pitch-black flute may not rot in a thousand years. It emits a low sound like trembling mountains, while its higher notes seem to be played by an orchestra; no matter what the tune is, it has the incredible power to please and move the audience.
Desc_226.cn: 干云质地玄黑，可经千年而不朽。其所奏低音，如泰山压顶；其所奏高音，似鼓角争鸣；无论吹奏何调，皆可感心动耳，宛如神物。

Desc_227.en: Completely dark when seen from afar, the flute may either play a slow tune that shakes the ground like rumbling drums and makes one shiver in fear, or an impassioned tune that seems like surging waves at the stormy sea. Those who hear the tune can still hear it in their heads for months, or worse—immediately lose their sanity.
Desc_227.cn: 玄铁箫色泽幽暗，远望漆黑一片，箫声低回处犹如鼙鼓动地，令人颤恐，高昂时好似巨浪滔天，使人震骇，得闻此声者，轻则月余犹闻回响，重则当场心离神散。

Desc_228.en: The heavy flute has a deeper sound than average flutes, but beginners may find it hard to produce a clear sound with it.
Desc_228.cn: 哑箫质地沉重，声音较寻常箫笛也更为低沉，初学者往往难以吹响，只得呕哑之音，故而谓之曰“哑箫”。
Desc_228.ru: Тяжелая флейта обладает более глубоким звучанием, чем обычные флейты, но новичкам может быть трудно добиться с ее помощью чистого звука.

Desc_229.en: With a silver crown and end, the thin flute produces a calm and clear sound that may not be very melodious, but it is good-quality for the price and quite popular amongst scholars alike.
Desc_229.cn: 银梢箫头、尾皆为银色，音色沉稳而清亮，箫管较细，虽略失于婉转，但物美价廉，颇受文人雅士喜爱。
Desc_229.ru: Тонкая флейта с серебряной головкой и наконечником издает спокойный и чистый звук, который, возможно, не очень мелодичен, но он хорошего качества по цене и довольно популярен как среди ученых, так и среди студентов.

Desc_230.en: A smiling Buddha is carved onto the flute that produces a cheerful sound. It may be used to play upbeat songs but not profound or sorrowful tunes.
Desc_230.cn: 笑面翁音色活泼，箫身刻有笑面佛像，故而得名。此箫轻快有余而深沉不足，虽能引出旁人心中的喜悦，却难以刻画悲伤。
Desc_230.ru: На флейте, издающей веселый звук, вырезан улыбающийся Будда. Его можно использовать для воспроизведения оптимистичных песен, но не глубоких или печальных мелодий.

Desc_231.en: Carved with a fenghuang's head on the crown, the flute produces a drawn-out tune that seems like bird chirps echoing on mountains or the sounds of rejuvenation in spring.
Desc_231.cn: 凤头箫刻有凤首，其声如鸟鸣，气到音出，余韵悠长，低处好似空谷回响，高时又如草长莺飞，可谓良箫矣。
Desc_231.ru: На короне флейты вырезана голова Фэнхуана, и флейта издает протяжную мелодию, которая кажется птичьим щебетом, эхом отдающимся в горах, или звуками весеннего обновления.

Desc_232.en: The flute produces a unique tune that sounds tender and affectionate as though accompanied by another flute, while a pair of loving mandarin ducks is gilded on the tube.
Desc_232.cn: 鸳鸯缠金箫音质独特，虽只有一箫，却如得另一箫相合。其声婉约而缠绵，因箫身以错金手法绘有一对交颈鸳鸯而得名。
Desc_232.ru: Флейта издает уникальную мелодию, которая звучит нежно и привязчиво, как будто ей аккомпанирует другая флейта, а на тубусе позолочена пара влюбленных уток-мандаринок.

Desc_233.en: Told to be made by flutist Li Mo during the reign of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, the short flute produces a sad and melancholic sound that may make one feel gutted and anguished while crying incessantly, even if not played by a master flutist.
Desc_233.cn: 相传愁断肠乃是唐玄宗年间，善于吹笛的李谟所创。此箫箫体短小，箫声悲切，纵非妙手吹奏，亦可使人心摧肠断，泪如雨下。

Desc_234.en: Legend says it that when Cangjie invented Chinese characters, rice fell from the sky while ghosts shrieked at night. Even after Cangjie perished, the flute still produces a sound that seems like the sharp and menacing shrill of ghosts.
Desc_234.cn: 鬼夜哭箫声清幽而尖锐，势欲破空。相传仓颉造字之时，天雨粟，鬼夜哭，如今仓颉早已仙去，而此箫之声却可如众鬼嚎哭一般，令人胆寒。

Desc_235.en: "With pleased sounds the deer call to one another, eating the southernwood of the fields. I have here admirable guests, whose virtuous fame is grandly brilliant." With a brilliant and rosy glow, the flute is strewn with spots that seem like a sika deer, while producing a harmonious and ethereal sound that is as clear and smooth as jade.
Desc_235.cn: 《诗》曰：“呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿。我有嘉宾，德音孔昭”。霞鹿箫身霞光满溢，上有点点斑纹，宛如麋鹿，其声和乐且湛，清灵如玉，故而得名。

Desc_236.en: Evil is that which deviates from righteousness. The flute is uniquely shaped with tone holes on both sides of the lip plate, so one needs to play it with both hands like a wild goose spreading its wings. It may produce sounds ranging from low to high tunes, making one feel serene and tranquil but slowly dazed and confused as though hearing the evil's call.
Desc_236.cn: 邪，即不正也。邪引形制独特，箫孔分布于吹口两侧，演奏时需双手横按于其上，宛如雁翔。其声低回如埙，平稳如箫，高音如笛，闻者只觉悠然高远，却会在不知不觉间恍恍惚惚，邪见丛生。

Desc_237.en: The warm and smooth flute produces a clear and airy sound. Despite it being a common flute, the agate patterns vary on each flute and so it is unique in its own way.
Desc_237.cn: 玛瑙箫质地温润，箫声清脆，虽是常见的玉箫，但因玛瑙的花纹多变，每支箫上的图案皆会有少许不同。
Desc_237.ru: Теплая и плавная флейта издает чистый и воздушный звук. Несмотря на то, что это обычная флейта, узоры из агата на каждой флейте различаются, и поэтому она по-своему уникальна.

Desc_238.en: The incandescent flute glows varying colors and produces a clear and fine tune—indeed an amusing music instrument that pleases both the eye and the ear.
Desc_238.cn: 彩石箫色彩斑斓，光华灵动，箫声清澈而细腻，既可悦耳，亦能娱目，颇有意趣。
Desc_238.ru: Флейта накаливания переливается различными цветами и издает чистую и тонкую мелодию — действительно, забавный музыкальный инструмент, который радует как глаз, так и слух.

Desc_239.en: The flute has a delightful sound that changes flexibly in tone, while the pattern upon it flickers dimly like ghosts from the underworld.
Desc_239.cn: 鬼纹短箫声音动听，变调灵活，箫身纹路明灭，色彩变幻，望之骇人，有如鬼物，故而得名。
Desc_239.ru: Флейта обладает восхитительным звуком, который гибко меняется по тону, в то время как узор на ней тускло мерцает, как призраки из подземного мира.

Desc_240.en: "At a wild temple, monks rest; Orioles sing, rain fades, clouds drift low." The flute produces a melodious tune that seeks the harmonic singing of orioles, building a sense of wild nature.
Desc_240.cn: “野寺寻僧宿，群莺隔树啼。一声山雨歇，数点乱云低”。寻莺箫声婉转，能引黄莺相和，颇有一番天然野趣。
Desc_240.ru: "В диком храме отдыхают монахи; поют иволги, дождь стихает, низко плывут облака". Флейта воспроизводит мелодичную мелодию, которая напоминает гармоничное пение иволги, создавая ощущение дикой природы.

Desc_241.en: The flute produces a rich and deep sound that seems imposing as though thousands of bees were flying out of their hive when an expert flutist blows quickly into the tube.
Desc_241.cn: 万蜂引音色圆润，每当吹奏者急速吐气之时，箫声便如万蜂飞出，嗡鸣不已，气势惊人，非精通音律者不可为也。
Desc_241.ru: Флейта издает насыщенный и глубокий звук, который кажется внушительным, как будто тысячи пчел вылетают из своего улья, когда опытный флейтист быстро дует в трубку.

Desc_242.en: Shaped like the crimson loong that is told to be the mount of immortals, the flute sounds fierce and powerful while emitting a faint and twinkling red glow as though it were alive.
Desc_242.cn: 相传赤龙乃是仙人坐骑。赤龙箫形如蛟龙，其声刚猛而雄浑，每当吹响之时，箫身红光便会若隐若现，仿佛有灵。
Desc_242.ru: По форме напоминающая малиновый Лун, который, как говорят, является горой бессмертных, флейта звучит яростно и мощно, излучая слабое мерцающее красное свечение, как будто она живая.

Desc_243.en: Adorned with a jade cicada on the tube, the flute sounds both ethereal like the evening cicada and profound like the ritual bell, filling one's heart with unspeakable sorrow.
Desc_243.cn: 蝉者，垂绥饮露，居高声远。暮蝉箫体以玉蝉为饰，箫声纤细，宛如寒蝉，飘然欲飞，又如钟磬之音，意境悠远，可令闻者感怀，难以言喻。
Desc_243.ru: Украшенная цикадой из Нефрита на трубке, флейта звучит одновременно неземно, как вечерняя цикада, и глубоко, как ритуальный колокол, наполняя сердце невыразимой печалью.

Desc_244.en: "Passing like this stream, ceaselessly flowing day and night." The flute is unique in nature and looks as though stars strewing over the sky had fallen into it and kept turning incessantly. It sounds like the bellow of surging rivers as well as the murmur of meandering streams, making one sigh over the fleeting time.
Desc_244.cn: 子在川上曰：“逝者如斯夫，不舍昼夜”。星河百转质地独特，望来好似浑天星子落入其中，运转不歇。其声宛如江河奔流，浩浩汤汤，又如暗流涌动，百转千回，可令闻者陡生川上之叹。

Desc_245.en: The flute sounds sharp like Kunlun jade shattering, which is told to "bring about the harmony between men and gods." The arcane music it produces is the most stunning piece shared between celestials and mortals before the separation of heaven and earth. It is said that "gods and ghosts are all intoxicated by the stunning music."
Desc_245.cn: 神鬼踏歌之声宛如昆山玉碎，相传可令“八音克谐，神人以和”，乃是绝地天通以前，人、神所共享。诗云：“钧乐由天降，神鬼踏歌来”，世间之美者，莫过于是。

Desc_246.en: As aqua blue as lake water, the flute is chilly and a few cun long, producing a melodious sound; it is one of the most common jade flutes found in the country.
Desc_246.cn: 水玉箫色如湖水，入手微凉，箫长数寸，其声婉转，乃是最为常见的玉箫之一。
Desc_246.ru: Голубая, как озерная вода, флейта прохладная, длиной в несколько сантиметров, издает мелодичный звук; это одна из самых распространенных флейт из Нефрита, найденных в стране.

Desc_247.en: Its color is emerald green, like a bone made of jasper, and its tone is high-pitched, with a feeling of sadness, so the poem describes it like this: "Wandering far on the sea, the sound of the flute echoes in the air."
Desc_247.cn: 翠骨箫通体碧绿，宛如玉骨，其声高亢，余响不绝，颇有悲慨之意，故有诗云：“飘游浮海去，吹箫向碧空”。

Desc_248.en: Carved from rare jade, the flute is only one cun long and decorated with lavish raden in the shape of natica snails, while producing a pleasing and mellifluous sound.
Desc_248.cn: 玉螺短箫乃是以美玉琢成，长仅寸许，其上嵌有螺钿，光华明丽，其声悠扬悦耳，其形清雅别致。
Desc_248.ru: Вырезанная из редкого Нефрита, флейта длиной всего в один цунь и богато украшенная радугой в форме улиток натики, издает приятный и сладкозвучный звук.

Desc_249.en: The flute sounds mellow and rich with overtones. Beginners may feel numbness in their hands before finishing an entire song with this flute, but once they grow used to it, they may play music that catches the audience's very souls.
Desc_249.cn: 摄魂箫箫声秀丽，泛音丰富，初学者甫用此箫演奏时，常常一曲未毕，便已双手发麻，但若能适应，便觉“摄魂”二字名副其实。

Desc_250.en: Legend tells that a piper rid a town of rats by luring them away with his music. The flute is named after the figure, as it sounds clear and enticing, capable of drawing the attention of birds in the sky and fish in the sea.
Desc_250.cn: 传说八仙之中，韩湘子最擅音律，曾借箫声与海中龙女传情。此箫以韩湘子为名，音色清透，余韵绵长，可令飞鸟侧目，游鱼驻足。

Desc_251.en: "The violet phoenix playfully holds the Chu pendant, Crimson scales dance wildly, stirring the Xiang strings." The dark purple flute sounds like wind blowing through bamboos and snow falling on pines, while the tube has a faint, auspicious glow that looks like a soaring purple fenghuang, which is told to symbolize faithfulness and loyalty.
Desc_251.cn: “紫凤放娇衔楚佩，赤鳞狂舞拨湘弦”。相传紫凤乃凤凰之属，坚贞不屈，此箫色紫近黑，其声宛如竹风松雪，箫身瑞光浮动，宛如凤翔，故而得名。

Desc_252.en: The glassy flute sounds as pure and clear as moonlight shining brightly over the seven seas and beyond the nine heavens, making one find serenity and tranquility as though watching "little egrets were flying over the pale moon."
Desc_252.cn: 素月璃骨色如琉璃，其声纯净清澈，如月华皎洁于四海之内，飘游于九天之外，闻者只觉心境空明，如见“渌水净素月，月明白鹭飞”之景。

Desc_253.en: "The Five Palaces of Xuandu untouched by worldly dust, The Three Isles of the Jade Sea shrouded in endless waves." Legend tells of a sea beyond the East Sea whose water tastes sweet instead of salty. The flute is made of jade from in the sea and sounds as pure and clear as flowing water, which may never change however time flies.
Desc_253.cn: “玄都五府风尘绝，碧海三山波浪深”，碧海在东海外，水不苦咸，甘香味美。碧海珍珑乃以美玉制成，其声琳琅若环佩，清泠如流水，可经沧海桑田而不改。

Desc_254.en: The white flute is adorned with thin red lines and told to be possessed by the spirit of the Three Life Stone. It produces an ethereal sound as though one were roaming across the serene realm of immortals, making one feel emotional and willing to die for their love, or even bringing the dead back to life.
Desc_254.cn: 玉人托心箫身洁白却沁有红纹，传说乃是三生石为情所感，而化精灵，寄于玉箫之中。此箫之声空灵纤细，宛如仙山云雾，宁静悠远，好似碧海青天，情思动人，婉然可叹，可令生者为之死，死者为之生。

Desc_255.en: Natural wood patterning is visible on the light wooden flute that produces a melodious sound; it is popular among beginners for being affordable and inexpensive.
Desc_255.cn: 木箫质地轻巧，其声悠扬，箫上可见天然木纹，因廉价易得，颇受初学者喜爱。
Desc_255.ru: На легкой деревянной флейте виден рисунок из натурального дерева, который издает мелодичный звук; она популярна среди начинающих благодаря своей доступности и недорогой стоимости.

Desc_256.en: Legend says it that Wu Yun was once homeless and played the flute for food after his father and brother were killed by the King of Chu. This very flute is made in the same way as Wu Yun's flute and produces a delightful and moving sound.
Desc_256.cn: 相传伍子胥父兄为楚王所害后，曾流落为丐，吹箫乞食。此箫声音婉转，呜然动人，与子胥当年所用之箫制法相同。

Desc_257.en: "Children rush to chase the yellow butterfly, Lost among the blossoms, nowhere to be found." Carved with a butterfly design, the greenish yellow flute is often played by hermits on mountains to express their contentment of living in poverty in the countryside.
Desc_257.cn: “儿童急走追黄蝶，飞入菜花无处寻”。黄蝶箫箫体青黄，上刻蝴蝶，山人隐士常用此箫吹奏乡音，以示安贫乐道，悠然自得。

Desc_258.en: Cai Yong once travelled to Keting in Kuaiji and made this flute from a unique bamboo beam found there. The flute produces a unique sound with emotional rise and fall, while its production method has been passed down to the present day.
Desc_258.cn: 柯亭箫本是蔡邕路经会稽时，以当地高迁亭中的屋椽所造。此箫含情抑扬，奇声独绝，制法历代相传，以至于今。

Desc_259.en: "At dusk, I return home; Green mist rises, veiling the twilight air." The flute plays a clear, drawn-out and nostalgic sound that makes one feel as though watching the sunset while smoke coils lazily toward the sky and birds return to the green woods.
Desc_259.cn: “薄暮归去来，苎萝生碧烟”。碧烟引箫声清远，归思深长，闻者似见日暮之时，炊烟四起，鸟倦还林之景。

Desc_260.en: Carved from peculiar wood, the flute emanates a lasting and aromatic scent while producing a faint and drawn-out sound, leaving a strong impression that makes one recall it even in dreams.
Desc_260.cn: 梦里听香乃是以奇木雕成，其香清幽，四时不绝，其声如缕，隐约不断，香、声一体，终成“听香”，可令闻者念念不忘，以至于梦中亦能记起。
Desc_260.ru: Вырезанная из особого дерева, флейта источает стойкий и ароматный аромат, издавая при этом слабый и протяжный звук, оставляющий сильное впечатление, которое заставляет вспоминать ее даже во сне.

Desc_261.en: "I find the green hills charming and fair; Perhaps they see me with the same fond stare." The flute sounds tender and melodious, and an expert flutist may roam the earth while playing it in perfect harmony with the nature, every note combined with the faint sounds of wind and waves to express deep affection and love.
Desc_261.cn: “我见青山多妩媚，料青山见我应如是”。烟波媚箫声婉转，脉脉如诉，善乐者秉此箫遨游于天地之间，穷音极响，以道和律，声韵之中，皆寄情言，隐约可闻山风呼应，水波相合。

Desc_262.en: "The sound of ancient times, taught by celestial immortals." It's said that the Astral Flute was created by Xiao Shi during the Qin Dynasty. Although this flute is made of spirit wood, its sound is completely different from other wooden flutes. The bass is like a leaf and the high pitch is like a whistle. It's so miraculous that it's called "Astral Flute."
Desc_262.cn: 相传天外奇音乃是秦穆公年间箫史所创，自谓：“上古之音，天人所授”。此箫虽以灵木制成，其声却与其他木箫毫不相似，低处如啸叶，高处如哨，欣然似人，世人无不称奇，故名之曰：“天外奇音”。

Desc_263.en: "Orchids bloom through spring and summer, lush and verdant. In the solitude of the deep forest, crimson petals crown purple stems." Straight and iron-like with obvious knots, the boneflute sounds as pure and elegant as orchids in secluded valleys, as sharp as the fenghuang's shrill; it is told to be created by the founder of music, Ling Lun, by order of the Yellow Emperor.
Desc_263.cn: “兰若生春夏，芊蔚何青青。幽独空林色，朱蕤冒紫茎”。独然骨箫体笔直，其质如铁，骨节分明，其声如空谷幽兰，华亭鹤唳，音和凤律，清逸不群，相传乃伶伦奉黄帝之命所创。

Desc_264.en: The flute is simply made in various shapes from common bamboos, and in the case of a short bamboo culm, nodes on both ends may be cut out to keep a complete flute tube and ensure the accuracy of its pitch.
Desc_264.cn: 青竹箫乃是以随处可见的青竹制成，形制灵活，工序简单，若遇竹节太短时，便可减去头、尾，只保证笛身完整，音准不失。

Desc_265.en: Carved with a serpent design, the thin and short flute sounds more uplifting than common wood flutes, with more flexible changes in tone; one needs more mouth and tongue skills to play the flute well.
Desc_265.cn: 蛇箫箫体细小，箫身刻有灵蛇，以为装饰。其声较寻常木箫而言更为高亢，转音灵活，吹奏时更注重舌上技巧。
Desc_265.ru: Тонкая и короткая флейта, украшенная резьбой в виде змеи, звучит более вдохновляюще, чем обычные деревянные флейты, с более гибкими изменениями тона; чтобы хорошо играть на флейте, нужно больше владеть ртом и языком.

Desc_266.en: The flute must be intricately made from rare materials and in dozens of steps that are said to be taught by immortals. Upon the flute are often carved with loong, fenghuang, mountain, river and poetry designs, while it produces an airy and elegant sound.
Desc_266.cn: 玉屏箫选材考究，制作精细，需经数十道工序方可造成，相传乃仙人所传。箫身常刻有龙凤、山水、诗文等图样，其声优美，音韵清越。

Desc_267.en: It consists of nine sections and is shaped like a cone. The inside and outside are painted with green paint and wrapped with tie wires. Its sound is clear, its appearance is beautiful, it is easy to play, and it lasts a long time.
Desc_267.cn: 碧漆九节箫共有九节，其形如锥，内外皆涂以碧漆，箫身更有扎线缠裹，于是乐声透亮，形制美观，易于吹奏，经久不坏。

Desc_268.en: The bamboo-colored flute has an archaic shape and sounds as gentle as the breeze in May when the warmth of spring rejuvenates the creatures on the earth.
Desc_268.cn: 青阳引色泽如竹，形制古朴，音色和柔，宛如阳春三月，万物苏生，正是：“青阳初入律，淑气应春风”。
Desc_268.ru: Флейта цвета бамбука имеет архаичную форму и звучит так же нежно, как майский ветерок, когда весеннее тепло омолаживает все живое на земле.

Desc_269.en: "I have always cherished the shadow of the jade railing, When lotus blooms upon the autumn water." Carved with cotton rose designs, the flute sounds as warm and bright as the early summer when a floral aroma wafts across a lake of lotus flowers beneath the scorching sun.
Desc_269.cn: “长爱碧栏干影，芙蓉秋水开时”。绣文芙蓉箫上刻芙蓉，其声清润明朗，宛如夏日方至，风送清香，满池荷花与红日相映，故而得名。

Desc_270.en: "The jade flute's melody fades beyond the clouded screen, Mountains distant, waters vast, yet memories linger." Made from rare spirit wood, the flute produces an unforgettable gentle sound that tugs at one's heartstrings. Legend says it that if one finds their soul mate, the sound of flute they play may reach a thousand li beyond the borders.
Desc_270.cn: “玉箫声断云屏隔，山遥水远长相忆”。长相忆乃是以罕见的灵木制成，其声柔和隽永，动人心弦，相传演奏者若是能与思念之人两情相悦，箫声便可飞度关山，传至千里之外。

Desc_271.en: During the Taikang Era of the Western Jin Dynasty, a garden of lily flowers suddenly appeared outside Yanmen, where a nameless hermit lived in a hut and played flute music. The lily garden and the hermit vanished when a war broke out, and only the production method of his flute was passed down to the present day.
Desc_271.cn: 相传西晋太康年间，雁门郡外忽现成片桃林，中有一人结庐而居，不知其所从来，亦不知其名姓，常以管弦自娱，土人奇之，故谓之曰“桃花仙”。其后天下大乱，桃林与其中仙人皆隐没不见，唯有制笛之法流传至今。

Desc_272.en: People have been tormented by the eternal sorrow derived from the impermanence of life and the insignificance of their existence as compared to the vast universe, so the flute is created as a pastime. It sounds ethereal and profound like the boundless sky with the bright moon and stars, bringing a melancholic feeling out of whomever hears it.
Desc_272.cn: 人生于世间，有感于天地之大，蜉蝣之寿，造化无常，千秋如是，往往慨然悲叹，无可纾解，故有先贤造万古愁，聊作慰藉。此箫之声浩瀚渺远，如长空皓月，九天星辰，世人闻此，只觉怅然若失，恍惚泣下。

Desc_273.en: Crudely crafted from pig iron, the gauntlets are used to hit the opponent with the knuckles; they are easy to hide and so often carried by aggressive and violent fighters.
Desc_273.cn: 铁手乃是以生铁简单打造而成的拳套，使用时需以指节发力，因此物易于藏匿，好勇斗狠之人往往随身携带。
Desc_273.ru: Грубо изготовленные из чугуна рукавицы используются для нанесения ударов по противнику костяшками пальцев; их легко спрятать, и поэтому их часто носят агрессивные и жестокие бойцы.

Desc_274.en: Worn on the four fingers excluding the thumb, the gauntlets have four ridges that may be used against the enemy; even the weakest person may equip them for self-protection.
Desc_274.cn: 四楞拳套乃是穿戴于四指之上、每指共有四处棱角的拳套，可利用凸起之处对敌，即便是文弱书生，亦能以之防身。
Desc_274.ru: Надеваемые на четыре пальца, исключая большой, перчатки имеют четыре выступа, которые можно использовать против врага; даже самый слабый человек может использовать их для самозащиты.

Desc_275.en: The gauntlets have metal engravings of tiger head designs on the back of the hands. They are heavy and fearsome, and the edges and sharp teeth on the tiger heads may also be used to attack others.
Desc_275.cn: 虎头铁掌套因掌背处以金铁雕成虎头形状而得名，此物质地沉重，拳风凌厉，亦可以虎首上的棱角、利齿伤人。
Desc_275.ru: На тыльной стороне перчаток выгравированы металлические изображения головы тигра. Они тяжелые и устрашающие, а края и острые зубы на головах тигров также могут использоваться для Атаки на других.

Desc_276.en: Forged from completely pure iron, the gauntlets are as quick as wind and as fierce as flames when one throws a punch in them.
Desc_276.cn: 浑铁，即纯铁。风火浑铁臂乃是以纯铁制成，绝无杂质，佩者出拳之时疾似劲风，侵略如火，威势惊人，故而得名。
Desc_276.ru: Выкованные из абсолютно чистого железа, перчатки быстры, как ветер, и яростны, как пламя, когда в них наносишь удар.

Desc_277.en: Carved with leopard and hornless loong designs, the ironfists emit a chilly light as though about to devour the enemy whole, surrounding one in a menacing air before they even make a move.
Desc_277.cn: 正所谓：“狡捷过猴猿，勇剽若豹螭”。豹螭铁手豹头而螭纹，其上寒光凛冽，如欲噬人，使用者尚未出手，而豪气已生。
Desc_277.ru: Украшенные узорами в виде леопардов и безрогих Лун, железные кулаки излучают холодный свет, как будто вот-вот поглотят врага целиком, окружая его угрожающим кольцом еще до того, как он сделает шаг.

Desc_278.en: The fists have the unparalleled strength of Prajna and will never be tainted. Legend says it that if one uses them with unswerving determination, they will be indestructible; but if they have any doubt, the fists will be like any common objects.
Desc_278.cn: 金刚臂坚固无比，宛如般若，不染纤尘，传说使用者若能一意专心，勇往直前，此物便不可毁坏；但如心怀犹疑，便泯然凡器。

Desc_279.en: "The loong adapts to the times, summoning wind and calling rain." Legend tells that loongs are capable of changing in size, and no ordinary human may match their divine power; but the loongcatchers move fast as lightning as one wishes, and not even the loong may escape from them.
Desc_279.cn: “龙乘时变，呼风唤雨”。相传神龙可大可小，因时而变，绝非凡夫俗子可以匹敌；然而擒龙手迅疾如电，可随穿戴者意动而发，即便是天龙也无法逃脱。

Desc_280.en: These powerful fists gleam like fireflies when one stays still in them, but glow brilliantly like the moon when one throws a punch; if the wearer becomes one with the fists, they will unleash divine power that shatters the earth and breaks mountains. As it is said, "radiant across the cosmos, gleaming bright, Unfolding the divine might of heaven and earth."
Desc_280.cn: 神威手声势浩大，光辉绚烂。佩者不动之时，光似萤火；出五分力时，辉如皓月；身意合一，则地崩山摧，真可谓：“粲宇宙兮光辉，张天地之神威”。

Desc_281.en: One may converge nearby corrupted air into a punch that severely bruises the enemy with the fists. The punch breaks one's meridians and makes one suffer from immense pain. As the saying goes: "One seal dissolves the form, two seals extinguish the soul."
Desc_281.cn: 青浊手可将四周浊气尽数汇集于掌力击打之处，在人体表面形成一道青色印记，是以得名。此印能断绝经脉，使人痛苦不堪，有“一印形消，两印魂灭”之说。

Desc_282.en: Made from wrought iron, the gauntlets are solid and hard to break, whilst heavy enough to help one throw a strong and powerful punch.
Desc_282.cn: 顽铁掌套乃是以熟铁制成，质地坚硬，不易损坏，因颇具分量，故而能使穿戴者的挥击更为有力。
Desc_282.ru: Изготовленные из кованого железа, перчатки прочные, их трудно сломать, и в то же время они достаточно тяжелые, чтобы помочь нанести сильный удар.

Desc_283.en: Made from steel that was processed repeatedly for tensile strength, the fists are indestructible and hard enough to crush bones. "Refined steel endures nine fires, yet weariness leaves its form unblemished."
Desc_283.cn: 精钢愈经锻炼，其质愈坚。碎骨精钢手以精钢制成，势可碎骨，坚硬不折，正是：“精钢试九火，劳倦容不槁”。

Desc_284.en: The gauntlets are tailored for the wearer and may be waved swiftly as though they weighed nothing, despite the might of steel they possess.
Desc_284.cn: 铁云掌套乃是根据使用者的手形精心锻造而成，虽势如疾风，但佩者只觉手中空空如也，只余云雾而已。
Desc_284.ru: Перчатки скроены специально для владельца, и ими можно быстро размахивать, как будто они ничего не весят, несмотря на мощь стали, которой они обладают.

Desc_285.en: "Thunder shatters mountains, lightning slays leviathans." The gauntlets are tough and tensile, capable of shattering the hardest boulder; one may often hear the faint rumble of thunder as well as ground breaking when waving them around.
Desc_285.cn: “雷震山岳碎，电斩鲸鲵死”。震山铁臂质地坚固，可击碎顽石，佩者出手时常能听闻隐隐雷鸣，如有排山倒海之威。

Desc_286.en: As it is said: "Vast and all-embracing, the power of Earth's essence." The soft-looking fists are in fact tough on the inside, countering motion with stillness with all-embracing tolerance for every creation in the world.
Desc_286.cn: 所谓：“光大含弘，坤元之力”。坤元臂外柔内刚，有履正怀冲，以静制动之势，亦有持载万物，博厚清明之德。

Desc_287.en: Shimmering like a slithering snake, the ironfists emit an angry thunderous roar when one wave them around, as though water were gushing down a-thousand-mile-high mountain. "Tearing through dark gorges with a thunderous roar, A thousand torrents surge forth in a mighty rush."
Desc_287.cn: 奔雷铁臂表面光华闪烁，宛如游蛇，挥动时好似霆霓怒吼，天门中开，真可谓：“擘开苍峡吼奔雷，万斛飞泉涌出来”。

Desc_288.en: The gauntlets are made up of glowing scales shaped like those of a loong, which may be opened or closed as one wishes: when opened, they bleed the enemy with razor-sharp edges; when closed, they decapitate the enemy like the divine loong with one simple blow.
Desc_288.cn: 龙鳞臂甲形如龙鳞，神光自生，其上鳞片可随穿戴者的心意或展开、或收束，展开时掌风如刃，必欲见血；收束时拳力似龙，只轻轻一击，便可使人身首分离。

Desc_289.en: "In the primordial beginning, formless and boundless chaos prevailed." The formless and transparent fists are both gentle and tough, quietly pulling out vigorous force from any attack as though it had hit a cluster of chaos at the beginning of the universe, whilst the wearer's movements all contain immense power.
Desc_289.cn: “大始未形，混沌无际”。混沌手无形无色，刚柔并济，宛如天地未分之时，能将一切劲力悄然化去，而佩者一举一动之间，却皆包含偌大威能。

Desc_290.en: The gauntlets are tough enough to break all things without any marks even when hit with a sharp weapon; but the tensile nether iron is extremely hard to smith and must be hot rolled in scorching fire.
Desc_290.cn: 玄铁掌套无坚不摧，浑然一体，即便与利器相撞也不会留下划痕，只是玄铁既为天下之至坚，故而极难锻造，唯有以炽火配合浇铸之法方可制成。
Desc_290.ru: Рукавицы достаточно прочны, чтобы ломать любые предметы без каких-либо следов даже при ударе острым Оружием; но растяжимое нижнее железо чрезвычайно трудно поддается ковке, и его необходимо подвергать горячей прокатке в обжигающем огне.

Desc_291.en: The claws are shaped like awls and hollow on one end to fit one's fingertips, while the front is curved like an eagle's claw and sharp enough to injure others.
Desc_291.cn: 鹰爪手末端空心，其形如锥，能与指尖贴合；前端弯曲，状若鹰爪，可以其锋伤人。
Desc_291.ru: Когти имеют форму шила и полые на одном конце, чтобы поместиться на кончиках пальцев, в то время как передняя часть изогнута, как коготь орла, и достаточно остра, чтобы ранить других.

Desc_292.en: The metal gauntlets cover one's entire hands and are mounted with spikes, which are shaped like wolf fangs and sharp enough to easily pierce skin.
Desc_292.cn: 狼牙手乃是覆盖全掌的金铁手套，因指节处的突刺形如狼牙而得名，其质坚锐，能轻易地划开肌肤。
Desc_292.ru: Металлические перчатки закрывают все кисти рук и снабжены шипами, которые по форме напоминают волчьи клыки и достаточно острые, чтобы легко проткнуть кожу.

Desc_293.en: The claws are impure silver with sprawling golden lines; sharp edges are hidden inside that may strike the enemy when least expected.
Desc_293.cn: 烂银金络爪底色如银，金纹交错，其上暗藏利刃，若在险要关头弹出，便能伤敌于不意之间。
Desc_293.ru: Когти из нечистого серебра с растянутыми золотыми линиями; внутри спрятаны острые края, которые могут поразить врага, когда он меньше всего этого ожидает.

Desc_294.en: Shaped like griffin claws, the gauntlets are flexible with rolling beads and barbs that may be used to strike down the enemy at the right moment.
Desc_294.cn: 灵鹫爪形如鹫鸟趾爪，其上附有滚珠、倒刺，十分灵活，佩者一旦寻得时机，便能借此重创敌人，故而得名。
Desc_294.ru: Рукавицы в форме когтей грифона гибкие, с перекатывающимися бусинами и зазубринами, которые можно использовать для нанесения удара по врагу в нужный момент.

Desc_295.en: In the shape of a coiling snake, the gauntlets may stretch out and lock any attacking weapon as fast as lightning with the power of thunder. As it is said, "The might of lightning flashing like golden serpents for thousands of zhang, And thunder roaring like the layered shells of a thousand spirit turtles."
Desc_295.cn: 金蛇锁弯曲如蛇，长短随心，可借势锁住迎面袭来的兵刃，真有“电掣金蛇千丈，雷震灵龟万叠”之威。

Desc_296.en: The gauntlets have extremely sharp thorns on the palm and two curved steel blades on the side, granting one the strength and power to tame a pride of lions without any disadvantage.
Desc_296.cn: 狮力勇猛，为诸兽之长，常与其类群居，精进无畏。搏狮手上尖刺如棘，侧边更有两把剑体弯曲的钢刃，锋锐无比，故而着此拳套者，可与群狮搏斗而不落下风。
Desc_296.ru: Перчатки снабжены чрезвычайно острыми шипами на ладони и двумя изогнутыми стальными лезвиями сбоку, что дает человеку Силу, позволяющую укротить львиный прайд без каких-либо неудобств.

Desc_297.en: "Jade hidden within stone—who can recognize it? Gold buried in earth—who can discern it?" The incredibly exquisite gauntlets are inserted with sharp blades on the index finger that may easily cleave metal and jadestones, leaving natural fractures instead of manmade cuts.
Desc_297.cn: “玉韫石中，何人识之；金藏土内，何人判之”。断玉分金精巧无比，唯双手食指之上装有尖刃，却能轻松地割开金铁、玉石，其截断处仿佛天然，非人力所为，因此得名。

Desc_298.en: The gauntlets are feared by many as they ignite a blue and ghostly flame like the will-o'-the-wisp, annihilating all spirits wherever it reaches and instantly turning everything into a void. Thus it is said: "The Spirit Crushers shatters the void."
Desc_298.cn: 青鬼破空能燃起冲天火焰，其色青幽，宛如鬼火。此火所到之处，寸草不生，万籁俱寂，可于一瞬之间使万物归于乌有，世人畏之，故谓曰：“青鬼破空”。

Desc_299.en: Forged by hot rolling pure gold with the true fire, the gauntlets are unadorned and indestructible; even though as thin as cicada wings, they will not change or perish even in millennia.
Desc_299.cn: 金胎手浑然天成，不可雕琢，唯有以真火熔炼真金，方能铸成。其质坚固不坏，物随心动，虽薄如蝉翼，却能万世不易、不腐不朽。
Desc_299.ru: Выкованные методом горячей прокатки чистого золота с использованием истинного огня, перчатки не имеют украшений и неразрушимы; несмотря на то, что они тонкие, как крылья цикады, они не изменятся и не погибнут даже через тысячелетия.

Desc_300.en: The chilly and frosty fists have a snow-white glow enveloping the five fingers, enhancing one's strength as though their bones were made of iron.
Desc_300.cn: 铁骨手质地冰凉，光如霜雪，笼罩五指，可令穿戴者宛如生有铁骨一般拳力陡增。
Desc_300.ru: Холодные и морозные кулаки имеют белоснежное сияние, окутывающее пять пальцев, увеличивающее Силу человека, как будто их кости сделаны из железа.

Desc_301.en: The aureate gauntlets cover the hands and forearms in the shape of two golden melons; they land heavy and powerful blows that often immobilize anyone hit.
Desc_301.cn: 金瓜臂色泽泛黄，覆盖范围由手及臂，因形如一对金瓜而得名。此物挥舞之时势大力沉，一旦被其击中，往往便会动弹不得。
Desc_301.ru: Золотистые рукавицы закрывают кисти и предплечья в форме двух золотистых дынь; они наносят тяжелые и мощные удары, которые часто обездвиживают любого, кого бьют.

Desc_302.en: Made of fine materials, these exquisite gauntlets have been worn by soldiers to perform King of Qin Breaking Up the Enemy's Front for morale boosting since the Zhenguan Era of the Tang Dynasty.
Desc_302.cn: 破阵臂甲取材精细，造型优美。相传自大唐贞观七年《秦王破阵乐》创制以来，甲士每逢表演破阵曲时，皆必着此甲，以壮军威。
Desc_302.ru: Изготовленные из высококачественных материалов, эти изысканные рукавицы надевались солдатами во время выступления короля Цинь, разбивающего вражеский фронт для поднятия боевого духа, начиная с эпохи Чжэньгуань династии Тан.

Desc_303.en: "A formation of sea clouds, strike hard like the Leigong, the god of lightning." The Lightning Gauntlets is green and black, and it seems to have spiritual Qi. Its power is astonishing, just like lightning, as if it is really from Leigong himself.
Desc_303.cn: 所谓：“屯结海云阵，奋击藉雷公”。雷公臂质地青黑，灵气仿佛，其势惊人，宛如雷殛，如此宝物，真似雷公亲手所传。

Desc_304.en: The wraps cover the five fingers and gleam a dazzling light. The wearer may throw a punch powerful enough to "send gusts of wind that cause storms and move mountains."
Desc_304.cn: 风云五指束裹覆五指，景光星粲，佩者甫一出手，便有风云自掌下生发，真所谓“掎拔而倾山岳，腾啸而御风云”也。
Desc_304.ru: Обертки закрывают пять пальцев и излучают ослепительный свет. Владелец может нанести удар, достаточно мощный, чтобы "вызвать порывы ветра, которые вызывают штормы и сдвигают горы".

Desc_305.en: The fists have a moderate brilliance while their power and strength equal those of "tidal waves that extend thousands of miles on end."
Desc_305.cn: 顷即百亩。千顷沧涛手光华内敛，其上力道却如千顷波涛，磅礴浩瀚，延绵不绝，真有“玄波振沧涛，洪津鼓万流”之势。
Desc_305.ru: Кулаки обладают умеренным блеском, в то время как их мощь и Сила равны "приливным волнам, которые простираются на тысячи миль в длину".

Desc_306.en: Legend tells that two descendants of the Kua'e family once moved Taihang and Wangwu Mountains by the order of the Lord of the Heavens. These gauntlets have such incredible strength and are told to be used by the Kua'e family to move mountains to fill up the sea.
Desc_306.cn: 夸娥氏，古之大力神也，其二子曾受天帝命，负太行、王屋于朔东、雍南。夸娥神臂伟力超凡，相传乃夸娥氏族人移山填海时所用。

Desc_307.en: Legend tells of a mythical sea creature with the head of a loong and the body of a fish, transformed from a divine artifact. The gauntlets seem intelligent with a flowing glow that grants the wearer the power to raise storms on the sea.
Desc_307.cn: 鲸龙者，龙首而鱼身，长如鲸鲵。相传鲸龙臂乃是神物所化，其上华光流动，如有灵智，佩者可得鲸吞四海、浪涌波翻之力。

Desc_308.en: The ancients said: "Eliminate the unrighteous, and the world shall find peace." The all-conquering fists are unstoppable even in front of millions of troops, with the power to exterminate all evil and restore peace to the world.
Desc_308.cn: 古人云：“诛灭无道，天下可定”。诛灭手无坚不摧、无邪不灭，虽将百万之军，其势亦不可挡，有平定海内、澄清寰宇之势，故而名之。

Desc_309.en: "Pale rouge washed clean by rain, Agate finely cut, thin as drifting clouds." The knuckles are solid in nature with sharp ridges that are not only for decoration but also perfect for defense.
Desc_309.cn: “浅淡胭脂经雨洗，剪裁玛瑙如云薄”。玛瑙指扣质地坚硬，棱角凸起，既是装饰，亦可作为防身之利器。
Desc_309.ru: "Бледные румяна, начисто смытые дождем, агат тонкой огранки, тонкий, как плывущие облака". Костяшки пальцев прочные по своей природе, с острыми выступами, которые служат не только для украшения, но и идеально подходят для защиты.

Desc_310.en: The wraps are linked with a beaded ring in the shape of the mythical Centuria Berry. Adorned with archaic patterning and thorny spikes, the wraps are capable of landing unstoppable blows that are focused on one critical point.
Desc_310.cn: 红珠一指束因有一枚形似朱果的指环与掌套相连而得名，其上纹饰古朴，暗藏尖刺，佩者可集掌力于一点之上，使人难以抵挡。

Desc_311.en: The knuckles glow ever-changing and phantom-like colors that draw the attention of the enemy unless they have absolute and firm beliefs, distracting them so that one may strike at the perfect moment.
Desc_311.cn: 幻光手五光徘徊，十色陆离，似真似幻，引人注目，心志不坚者若在对敌时被此光吸引，便会坐失良机。
Desc_311.ru: Костяшки светятся постоянно меняющимися призрачными цветами, которые привлекают внимание противника, если только у него нет абсолютных и твердых убеждений, отвлекая его, чтобы можно было нанести удар в подходящий момент.

Desc_312.en: The knuckles are spotless white and yet emit beams of resplendent and enchanting glows when waved around that seem like the glorious light of the sun. "Embracing Yin and cradling Yang, a harmonious aura permeates all."
Desc_312.cn: 霞光臂洁白无瑕，舞动时却能发出道道霞光，斑斓绚烂，美不胜收，真可谓：“负阴抱阳，和气氤氲”。

Desc_313.en: Strewn with gemstone fragments, the knuckles gleam faintly like the twinkling stars as well as flashing lightning—marvelously embodying a poetic and idyllic night under the bright moon and stars. Just as: "Clearing clouds disperse, yet the dawn moon remains bright, Sparse trees hang with lingering stars."
Desc_313.cn: 残星手乃是由宝石碎片点缀而成，其上微光点点，好似星子，又如流电，正如：“霁霞散晓月犹明，疏木挂残星”。

Desc_314.en: If the wearer has the intention to kill, the thin white threads hidden inside open up to reveal a pair of ghostly and sinister eyes that split the enemy's vital organs; but if the wearer doesn't intend to kill, the ghost eyes stay closed as glowing white lines.
Desc_314.cn: 如意鬼手中藏有一道白线，佩者若有意伤人，则此线张开似鬼眼，煞气腾腾，使人肝胆俱裂；若无意伤人，则鬼眼闭合，只余一道如线白光。

Desc_315.en: The knuckles are a collection of beautiful jadestones that shine brilliantly like the twinkling stars on the Milky Way when waved around, as though one had soared up to the celestial realm.
Desc_315.cn: 百曜手乃是由诸般美玉汇集而成，光华璀璨，宛若天河，舞动之时只见星辰闪烁，彩彻区明，真不知天上人间，吾所安在。
Desc_315.ru: Костяшки пальцев - это коллекция красивых жадеитовых камней, которые сияют ослепительно, как мерцающие звезды на Млечном пути, когда ими размахивают, как будто человек воспарил в небесное царство.

Desc_316.en: The knuckles are tough and adorned with jadestones carved into the shape of Divine Loongs that look intricate and vivid as though they were coming to life, emitting a forbidding loong roar when the wearer waves them around.
Desc_316.cn: 磐龙手因有宝玉雕成的神龙盘踞于其上、又坚固如磐石而得名。此龙纤毫毕现，栩栩如生，每当佩者挥动磐龙手时，便有龙吼传出，声势惊人。

Desc_317.en: The knuckles are clear and tensile with a rainbow glow and brilliance, chiming like jade in the hands of someone sagacious, and yet dimming when worn by someone vile; and so named "Empress Knuckles" for their precious nature and nobility.
Desc_317.cn: 帝女心质地清澈，折而不挠，内蕴七道霞光、诸般奇景，若置于圣贤手中，则有环佩之声；落入小人之手，则晦暗不明；因珍贵异常，意气高洁，故称“帝女心”。

Desc_318.en: Instead of covering the five fingers, the intricate, charming knuckles adorn one's hand and wrist with aquamarine crystals that clink clearly when equipped.
Desc_318.cn: 晶玉指扣清秀可爱，琳琅有声，乃是裸露五指，以水色玉石装饰于指节、手腕之间的掌套。
Desc_318.ru: Вместо того чтобы закрывать пять пальцев, замысловатые очаровательные костяшки украшают кисть и запястье кристаллами аквамарина, которые отчетливо позвякивают при надевании.

Desc_319.en: The frosty knuckles are crafted from jade in the shape of the calyx of a flower, stunning and elegant, with thin and sharp sepals to injure others. Truly, it is said: "Petals formed by the palm, jade shaped as calyx."
Desc_319.cn: 冷萼手形如花萼，质如霜雪，真可谓：“掌作花，玉为萼”，清丽秀雅，艳而不俗。其上萼片薄而锋利，可以之伤人。

Desc_320.en: "Floating jade and soaring crystals, gracing secluded halls and serene pavilions, enhancing their pure and transcendent beauty." Legend tells that when Queen Mother of the West met Emperor Wu of Han, she once asked her maids to play drums and flutes to welcome the emperor, while an air of purity drifts from the maiden hands like heavenly petals falling from the sky.
Desc_320.cn: “浮玉飞琼，向邃馆静轩，倍增清绝”。相传王母与武帝相会时，曾命侍女飞琼鼓笙相迎，飞琼手清气飘然，宛如琼华自天而降，故而得名。

Desc_321.en: Carved from spotless jade, the knuckles are linked with a dozen or so small beads that emit a gurgling sound of water when the wearer moves in them. "The dim glow of the waning moon shrouded in haze, Distant waters echo with crystalline clarity."
Desc_321.cn: 水玲珑乃是以无瑕美玉制成，其上串联有十数小珠，佩者甫一动作，便有流水琤琮之声，正是：“残月华晻暧，远水响玲珑”。

Desc_322.en: "May I be the star, and you the moon. Night after night, our radiant glow remains pure and bright." The knuckles are made up of rings like the stars connected to a wristlet like the moon, the brightness of which exceeds that of the snow, while carrying a ceaseless longing for one's lover.
Desc_322.cn: “愿我如星君如月，夜夜流光相皎洁”。孀娥指扣指环似星，腕饰如月，星月相连，皎洁胜雪，寄托着不尽的相思之情。

Desc_323.en: The pure and unadorned knuckles are engrossed in an air as frosty as the chilly and secluded palace of the moon, where white hares, toads and osmanthus flowers grow in the cold. "Beneath the grass, insects hide from frost. The cold moon chills the jade rabbit, the laurel blossoms pale."
Desc_323.cn: 蟾魄手清净无瑕，寒气缭绕，真如广寒清虚之府一般，清冷孤绝。诗云：“草下阴虫叶上霜，兔寒蟾冷桂花白”，此之谓也。

Desc_324.en: The knuckles are a pair of hand ornaments shaped like two lotuses with double layers of blooming petals, while glowing dazzlingly and brilliantly like a pair of light and elegant butterflies fluttering their wings over lotuses. "Butterflies always dance in pairs; and twin lotuses bloom as one."
Desc_324.cn: 并蒂莲骨乃是一对形如并蒂莲花的掌饰，其上花开重瓣，轻盈如蝶，光彩炫目，动人心魄，真可谓：“俱飞蛱蝶元相逐，并蒂芙蓉本自双”。

Desc_325.en: The knuckles are shaped like a spiritual loong snake that has the horns of a loong and yet hasn't transformed into one. They are frosty in nature and may fly back and forth to wound others with their extreme chilly aura.
Desc_325.cn: 龙蛇似龙而非龙，乃是有角能飞，却还不曾化龙的灵蛇。龙蛇冰绡状若龙蛇，质如冰绡，能自行飞出飞回，以寒气伤人。

Desc_326.en: "The Bodhi nature is inherently pure; Simply by this mind, one attains enlightenment." Repelling dirt and filth in the world of mortals, the knuckles are capable of removing all secular desires, freeing one from worries, and returning them to their most natural state so they may perceive the world in its truest form.
Desc_326.cn: “菩提自性，本来清净，但用此心，直了成佛”。无垢不染尘世污浊，能使人断绝妄心，不起妄念，解脱妄想，清净本然，了悟诸相非相。

Desc_327.en: Made up of small wooden platelets linked together, the strikers are like ordinary gloves but more flexible and less likely to affect the wearer's movement.
Desc_327.cn: 木手甲乃是以细小的木片拼接而成，其形恰如普通拳套，但伸缩灵活，不容易影响到穿戴者的行动。
Desc_327.ru: Состоящие из маленьких деревянных пластинок, соединенных вместе, бойки похожи на обычные Перчатки, но более гибкие и с меньшей вероятностью влияют на движения владельца.

Desc_328.en: The wraps are light to wear and shaped like a gracefully soaring fenghuang, with only one ring around the index finger connected to the gloves.
Desc_328.cn: 凤飞一指束轻灵秀美，状若凤凰高飞，因仅有一枚指环与掌套相连，佩戴于食指之上，故而得名“一指束”。
Desc_328.ru: Накидки легки в носке и имеют форму грациозно парящего Фэнхуана, с единственным кольцом на указательном пальце, соединенным с Перчатками.

Desc_329.en: The solid and tough claws are strewn with red dots like maple leaves covering the forest floor; the wearer may strike with the sharp claws or pull the trigger to shoot out the concealed poison.
Desc_329.cn: 碎红爪质地坚韧，上有点点赤色，宛如霜林落枫；其形似爪，穿戴者既能以爪尖伤人，亦可扣动机括，发射其中暗藏的毒物。
Desc_329.ru: Твердые и выносливые когти усыпаны красными точками, как кленовые листья, покрывающие лесную подстилку; владелец может нанести удар острыми когтями или нажать на спусковой крючок, чтобы выпустить скрытый Яд.

Desc_330.en: "Plum blossoms and snow vie for spring, neither willing to yield, Poets lay down their brushes, unable to judge their beauty." The crimson and white strikers have clear bone nodes while emitting a faint fragrance and chilly air, as though plum trees were blooming in the snow and heralding the arrival of spring.
Desc_330.cn: “梅雪争春未肯降，骚人阁笔费评章”。梅雪争春红白相间，骨节分明，暗香浮动，寒意隐约，真如如梅雪相映，争报春归一般。

Desc_331.en: The strikers emanate herbal fragrances or sweet aromas of crops depending on the time and season, which are capable of banishing evil and suppressing devilish spirits.
Desc_331.cn: 天香伏邪手有草木之芬芳，五谷之甘美，诸般香气因时而异，能驱逐邪秽，降伏精魅，可谓香之至矣，故名“天香”。
Desc_331.ru: От бойков исходят ароматы трав или сладких культур, в зависимости от времени года, которые способны изгонять зло и подавлять дьявольских Духов.

Desc_332.en: "Pale petals, soft and pure; Fragrance lingers, unmatched by hue." The strikers have the flaxen color and faint fragrance of osmanthus, and much like the flower, they haven't gained great fame and yet have an exceptional and unbreakable spirit.
Desc_332.cn: “暗淡轻黄体性柔，情疏迹远只香留。何须浅碧深红色，自是花中第一流”。轻黄手颜色、香气皆如桂花一般，虽声名不显，但气节不屈，堪称一流。

Desc_333.en: Mara is a demonic celestial king who takes intelligent lives and can only be subdued by a bodhisattva. But with these gauntlets, the Wisdom King may manifest in an unparalleled light to slay all demonic beings.
Desc_333.cn: 魔，又称魔罗，可夺取慧命，妨害众生，菩萨证灭修道，方能摄伏。降魔神木臂神异无比，可显现明王法身，以无上光明斩却外魔。

Desc_334.en: "One might think it crafted by the River Goddess of Luo. A thousand charms shattering the morning glow." The dawnbreakers are shaped like an ever-changing peony more stunning than the twilight at dawn, and many are amazed by the beauty and believe the Goddess of the River Luo transformed into them.
Desc_334.cn: “疑是洛川神女作，千娇万态破朝霞”。破朝霞形似牡丹，千姿百态，光色陆离，过于朝霞，使人赞叹不已，疑为洛川神女所化。

Desc_335.en: Shaped like morning dew, the blood-red strikers are capable of absorbing life energy to nurture themselves and making the enemy bleed even without a sharp blade; the wearer will gradually gain strength as they fight their enemy with these on.
Desc_335.cn: 滴血露华形如朝露，血色浓郁，虽无锋刃，却能汲取精气，滋养自身，每逢挥动，必有血光闪烁；佩者以之对敌，则此消彼长，愈战愈勇。

Desc_336.en: Simply twined from bamboo strips, the strikers are smooth and soft to wear, but easily worn out.
Desc_336.cn: 以竹篾简易编织而成的拳套，外表光滑，内里柔软，穿戴舒适，但容易破损。
Desc_336.ru: Просто скрученные из бамбуковых полосок, бойки гладкие и мягкие в носке, но легко изнашиваются.

Desc_337.en: "After night's rain subsides by dawn, The empty mountain breathes with crisp autumn air." The gloves are chilly to the touch and so soft that they feel nonexistent on the hands, just like the spring rain nourishing the earth at night without a sound.
Desc_337.cn: “宿雨朝来歇，空山秋气清”。宿雨手质地冷凉，柔似无物，恰似夜雨无声，晨起方知。

Desc_338.en: These soft and light gloves are in the shape of intertwining vines, capable of making the wearer strike as fast and nimbly as silverbacks leaping on mountains. "Mountain apes rest beyond the clouds, Forest birds ride the wind back home."
Desc_338.cn: 猿公手轻便柔软，形如盘根，能令穿戴者行动灵敏，宛若“山猿隔云住，林鸟乘风归”。

Desc_339.en: As smooth as silk, the Demonseal Wraps are connected to a talisman that may repel evil and suppress demons when waved around.
Desc_339.cn: 缚妖五指束质地滑如丝绸，指束上裹有符咒，挥舞时能以灵符驱邪，束缚群妖。
Desc_339.ru: Гладкие, как шелк, обертки из демонической печати соединены с талисманом, который может отталкивать зло и подавлять демонов, если им размахивать.

Desc_340.en: The Misted Strikers come like the dazzling sunset glow and yet leave in only a mist of dawn, unpredictable like the cloud of rain or the midnight dew.
Desc_340.cn: 杏黄朝烟手黄中带红，如同杏子，来如夕焰，去似朝烟，浅深聚散，万取一收，好似浮云带雨，夜露凝愁。
Desc_340.ru: Запотевшие нападающие появляются подобно ослепительному зареву заката и в то же время уходят лишь в рассветной дымке, непредсказуемые, как дождевое облако или полуночная роса.

Desc_341.en: "Qian is the sky and Kun is the earth." The Qian Kun Strikers is light and tough. It is a pair of strikers divided into Qian Striker and Kun Striker. The Qian Striker symbolizes the sky and can destroy all things. The Kun Striker symbolizes the earth and can accommodate all things.
Desc_341.cn: 正所谓：“乾为天，坤为地”。乾坤臂轻巧坚韧，寸寸相连，乃是一双分为乾臂、坤臂的拳套，其中乾者象天，似能摧山断海，坤者象地，似可包容万物。

Desc_342.en: The Bloodlust Strikers look menacing from afar as though one's hands were tainted by fresh blood. Legend tells that the obscure fragrance on these gloves may remove the smell of blood, and the more blood the strikers absorb, the brighter their color becomes.
Desc_342.cn: 暗香血趾血色凝而不散，幽香似有若无，远望宛如双手为鲜血浸染，令人心悸，相传其香能掩去血腥，且饮血越多，颜色愈加鲜亮。

Desc_343.en: The Loongcoil Strikers with gold patterning repel all wind and rain and may bend one's surroundings like the flood loong soaring to the sky, as the wearer's fist arts will turn green grass and woods into empty, lifeless fields.
Desc_343.cn: 玄色蟠龙手玄底金纹，龙威内蕴，不受风侵雨渍，可如蛟龙腾空，变幻风云，佩者拳掌所至，草木无不尽匐，山林化而成空。

Desc_344.en: The Marvel Strikers seem to be naturally made and may fit perfectly on one's hands. With the ability to change into different forms as one pleases, they are marvelous artifacts believed to be not of this earth.
Desc_344.cn: 妙叹无形无色，浑然天成，能自行贴合于人手之上，又可随佩者的心意变化为各种形态，此非人世之物，观者无不叹服。

Desc_345.en: Cut from a complete tiger hide, the tiger claws are soft and tensile, allowing one to move freely in them and even landing mighty blows.
Desc_345.cn: 虎爪手乃是由整块虎皮通裁而成，质地柔韧，穿戴者只觉行动自如，掌风猎猎生威。
Desc_345.ru: Вырезанные из цельной тигровой шкуры, тигриные когти мягкие и растяжимые, что позволяет свободно передвигаться в них и даже наносить мощные удары.

Desc_346.en: Adorned with wild beast designs and coated with fluffy fur, the gloves are comfortable to wear, except for in summer when they may be too warm.
Desc_346.cn: 兽纹手套造型粗犷，其上可见猛兽斑纹，又附有绒毛，穿着舒适，只是到了炎炎夏日时，未免失于凉爽。
Desc_346.ru: Перчатки, украшенные рисунками диких зверей и покрытые пушистым мехом, удобно носить, за исключением лета, когда в них может быть слишком тепло.

Desc_347.en: It consists of two gloves, one for Yin and one for Yang. The Yin one is soft and gentle, and you fight with dexterity; the Yang one is strong and fierce, and you fight with brute force. The usage of it is flexible, and the wearer can use both Yin and Yang, or focus on one of them.
Desc_347.cn: 阴阳手共有两只掌套，其一为阴，另一为阳。阴者和柔，以巧取胜；阳者刚猛，以力破敌；此物用法灵活，佩者既可阴阳并出，也可侧重一方。

Desc_348.en: The gloves are tensile and as thin as cicada wings, but when the wearer assaults the enemy, the force of their palms strikes from all directions in a radius, catching one off guard.
Desc_348.cn: 天、地、四方，谓之六合。六合掌套质地柔韧，薄如蝉翼，然而佩者出手之时，掌力便会从四面八方袭来，令人防不胜防，避无可避。
Desc_348.ru: Перчатки эластичны и тонки, как крылья цикады, но когда их владелец нападает на врага, сила его ладоней поражает со всех сторон по радиусу, застигая врасплох.

Desc_349.en: Shaped like sharp claws, the nightcallers are completely black and easy to hide in the darkness of the night. Legend says it that when the gloves take someone's life, a wail comes out that sounds like a trapped beast and may stop an infant's cry at night.
Desc_349.cn: 夜吼形如利爪，遍体漆黑，可融于夜色，极为隐蔽。相传每当以夜吼取人性命时，便会有悲鸣传出，其声如困兽，能止小儿夜啼。

Desc_350.en: The light and soft gloves wrap around one's entire hands and emanate a refreshing fragrance, leaving only five shadowy trails when the wearer lands their blow, so that others may not tell from which direction the strike will come.
Desc_350.cn: 五影参差裹覆全手，质地轻柔，清气隐约，舞动之时，只能看见五道参差不齐的残影，而无法分清手在何方、力在何处，故而得名。

Desc_351.en: The gloves may seem crude at first glance but are ingeniously made with no start, end or seam left in the threads, while adorned with turning stars that symbolize the chaotic universe. "Nature's workings revealed, what need for celestial tools?"
Desc_351.cn: 混天织无头无尾，无端无绪，拙中藏巧，浑然天成，其上星斗流转，有翻江倒海、囊括天地之势，可谓：“造化运可见，浑天何用仪”。

Desc_352.en: The gloves are made up of linings as soft as feathers, gold scales like those of the Qilin, and aureate ribbons; when waved around, they are often accompanied by clouds and sudden rain. "Feather ribbons flutter in the wind, and the golden Qilin flies in the rain."
Desc_352.cn: 羽绶金麟内衬柔软如羽，其上覆盖金鳞，状如麒麟甲，又饰以金色飘带，因此得名；舞动之时，常见云雾相随，倏然雨下，故有诗云：“羽绶随风动，金麟带雨飞”。

Desc_353.en: The intricate gloves are tough and tensile, indestructible like the Buddha; they are semi-transparent, with a golden glow only when the wearer throws a punch as though a gilt cicada's wings were fluttering.
Desc_353.cn: 金蝉手套制法精巧，外刚内韧，如同佛祖金身一般，无可毁坏；其质清透，唯有使用者出掌之时，方会闪现金色光华，浑似金蝉振翅而飞。

Desc_354.en: A pair of leather gauntlets that is usually made from fur found by local folks on hills; it wraps around one's hands and has a faint smell of blood.
Desc_354.cn: 以动物毛皮制成的护手，略带腥气，因山民常就地取材，制成此物以包裹双手而得名。
Desc_354.ru: Пара кожаных перчаток, которые обычно шьются из меха, найденного местными жителями на холмах; они обтягивают руки и имеют слабый запах крови.

Desc_355.en: Made from tanned animal hides, the gloves are soft to the touch and light to carry, with a charming yellow striped print that symbolizes the wilderness.
Desc_355.cn: 黄纹手乃是取野兽毛皮鞣制而成，柔韧轻便，质地细腻，黄纹纵横，颇有野趣。
Desc_355.ru: Изготовленные из дубленых шкур животных, Перчатки мягкие на ощупь и легкие в переноске, с очаровательным принтом в желтую полоску, символизирующим дикую природу.

Desc_356.en: Adorned with a cloud patterning, the white gloves look graceful from afar like a pair of crane birds, as well as misty clouds when seen up close, emitting an endless wind sound like cranes howling when the wearer attacks.
Desc_356.cn: 鹤唳盘云手质地洁白，以云纹为饰，远而望之，灵动可比双鹤，迫而察之，蔼蔼好似烟云，佩者出掌时风声不绝，有如鹤唳。

Desc_357.en: The polished and pristine gloves may facilitate the wearer's movement and make them more agile, as their blows carry the chilly autumn gale and their palms hold the bright azure sky. Gazing upon it is like: "Evening rain sweeps the river sky, cleansing autumn anew."
Desc_357.cn: 掌清秋质地清透，素净皎洁，可令佩者行动不滞，应变及时，拳携凉露之风，掌托高天之明，望之有如“潇潇暮雨洒江天，一番洗清秋”。

Desc_358.en: The resplendent gloves are light and gleaming while wrapped in an ethereal mist and gentle breeze. The wearer moves in them as though a loong and fenghuang were soaring on land and water, weaving rosy clouds into gorgeous brocade.
Desc_358.cn: 龙凤织云手华光交织，质地轻盈，云气缭绕，运之有风，佩者出手时宛若龙飞白水，凤翔参墟，织云似锦，彩霞如画。

Desc_359.en: The gloves have an ocean wave and white cloud patterning with an iridescent glow, and the wearer seems as though waving a hazy and dreamlike rainbow above clouds or stirring up glimmering ripples when moving in them.
Desc_359.cn: 五光织纹如海浪，又似轻云，五光徘徊，十色陆离，舞动时宛若虹光在手，清波漾漾，如梦如幻，美不胜收。

Desc_360.en: The light gloves have a pure and stunning shine that surpasses the twinkling stars and sunset clouds when they unfurl as though returning from the divine void.
Desc_360.cn: 归霞质地轻盈，清辉绮烂，盈缩卷舒、寄心寓目之间，有如奔星俯驰，夕霞敛色，虚伫神素，妙契同尘。
Desc_360.ru: Легкие Перчатки обладают чистым и ошеломляющим блеском, который превосходит мерцающие звезды и облака на закате, когда они раскрываются, словно возвращаясь из божественной пустоты.

Desc_361.en: The iridescent gloves are strangely shaped like nine peculiar flowers that blossom perpetually, but also like the twinkling Ursa Major stars that shine permanently above—symbolizing heavenly herbs and frosty brilliance.
Desc_361.cn: 画九英光彩昭焕，形貌瑰异，宛如九种奇花，长开不谢，又似钟山之英，经火不改，真乃仙草灵葩，冰华玉仪。

Desc_362.en: "There is not much difference between clouds and clay, they both exist in this world." With a complex patterning and structure, the mighty gloves may grant one the power to change weather and environment with a flick of the finger.
Desc_362.cn: “勿言云泥异，同在逍遥间”。泥云手纹理交错，构造复杂，威能广大，通天彻地，佩者如可一手化云，一手化泥，翻手为云，覆手为雨。

Desc_363.en: Simply made from linen cloths, the bandages are wrapped around one's wrists and knuckles, connecting the power of one's palms, wrists and arms.
Desc_363.cn: 缠手带乃是以麻布制成，工序简单，使用时缠裹于手腕、指节附近，可将掌腕、手臂之力连为一体。
Desc_363.ru: Повязки, просто сделанные из льняной ткани, оборачиваются вокруг запястий и костяшек пальцев, соединяя силу ладоней, запястий и предплечий.

Desc_364.en: "The warbling oriole, fond of me still, sings all day by the willows in the spring breeze." The pair of gloves has the colors, sounds and agility of the small and charming warbler birds that chirp by the willow trees to herald the arrival of spring.
Desc_364.cn: “流莺有情亦念我，柳边尽日啼春风”。流莺手色如流莺，声如流莺，灵动亦如流莺，小巧玲珑，惹人喜爱。

Desc_365.en: The plain gloves with a smooth design are capable of thoroughly bringing forth one's techniques without altercation.
Desc_365.cn: 化意手朴实无华，造型流畅，能将使用者心中所想的招式淋漓尽致地发挥出来，故称“化意”。
Desc_365.ru: Простые Перчатки с гладким рисунком способны полностью отработать технику без каких-либо препирательств.

Desc_366.en: The gloves are made up of hundreds of flowers and gold threads, emanating a rich fragrance that spreads miles away. The wearer may either use the aroma to distract the enemy or land a heavy blow with the gloves.
Desc_366.cn: 百卉金丝手取百种花卉为布，缠以金丝，往往未见其物，先闻其香，使用者既可以清香扰敌，亦能以掌力伤人。

Desc_367.en: "The passing water flows eastward, the front wave and the back wave connect." The gloves are light and gentle, but the forces that pass through them are never-ending and relentless like torrential water, trapping one inside when least expected.
Desc_367.cn: 正所谓：“逝水向东流，前后浪相续”。逝水质地轻柔，其上力道却如流水一般悠悠不绝，应对时稍有不慎，便会陷入其中，难以逃脱。

Desc_368.en: The intricately woven gloves have ever-changing patterns on both sides with colors that vary when seen at different angles and time—indeed a pair of ingenious gloves made for versatile use. Truly: "A thousand ingenious arts, all contained within."
Desc_368.cn: 千般巧织法巧妙，能形成正反两面不一的图样，观者若从不同的方位、时刻中看去，则其色迥异，真可谓：“千般巧技，尽在其中”。

Desc_369.en: The gloves are as cold as permafrost, while murky and nebulous like an apparition. If one makes a move in them, the air will be filled with chilly frost, as sinister spirits roam the earth as though in the Freezing Hell.
Desc_369.cn: 玄冰鬼趾寒意逼人，好似万年玄冰；其质飘乎不定，如同鬼影。佩者出手之时，只见冰霜漫天，鬼影呼啸，阴森可怖，如同身处八寒地狱一般。

Desc_370.en: Legend says it that the gloves are turned from the blood of a flood loong. The mighty and majestic gloves are unpredictable when waved around, summoning rainstorm clouds as though a thousand horned loongs were curling on one's hands, ready to strike at the perfect moment. Indeed: "Coil with grandeur, soar like flying eaves."
Desc_370.cn: 相传千螭乃是蛟龙神血所化，挥舞之时气势恢宏，变幻莫测，而又常见乌云密布，宛如千条螭龙盘踞手上，伺机而动，正是：“螭蟠得形势，翚飞如轩户”。

Desc_371.en: Woven from panthea silk, the feathery gloves are indestructible and all-encompassing, capable of repelling flames and water and exploiting the enemy's weakness to counter their strength.
Desc_371.cn: 天蚕掌套乃是以天蚕丝织成，其质轻如无物，水火不侵，韧不可摧，有虚怀若谷、海纳百川之势，亦能以柔克刚，遇强则强。
Desc_371.ru: Перчатки с перьями, сотканные из шелка пантеи, неразрушимы и всеобъемлющи, способны отражать пламя и воду и использовать слабость противника, чтобы противостоять его Силе.

Desc_372.en: Woven from jute, the crudely made gloves are low-priced but durable; also thin enough to make them cool and breathable in summer.
Desc_372.cn: 以黄麻编织而成的掌套，外观粗糙，廉价耐用，清凉透气，纹理粗疏。
Desc_372.ru: Грубо сделанные Перчатки, сотканные из джута, недороги, но долговечны; к тому же они достаточно тонкие, чтобы летом в них было прохладно и воздухопроницаемо.

Desc_373.en: Made up of plain cotton gauze laced with exquisite embroidery, the wraps are comfortable to wear but also pleasing to the eye.
Desc_373.cn: 以素纱为底，刺绣为文，即为纳锦。纳锦五指束乃是由棉麻织成，质地柔软，绣工细致，穿着舒适而又不失美观。
Desc_373.ru: Изготовленные из простой хлопчатобумажной марли, украшенной изысканной вышивкой, обертывания удобны в носке, но также приятны для глаз.

Desc_374.en: "Clear streams shimmer, white herbs flourish." The clear stream is full of water, and the luxuriant white peony is growing. The greenish white gloves are capable of emitting a pungent herbal fragrance that bewitches travelling scholars and even passersby.
Desc_374.cn: “泛滟清流满，葳蕤白芷生”。幽芷手白中透绿，幽香扑鼻，能令游子忘归，行人止步，故而得名。

Desc_375.en: The thin and flexible gloves have emerald and blue dots shaped like fangs on the fingertips, as well as engravings on the palms that look from afar like green mountains shrouded in misty clouds.
Desc_375.cn: 碧牙手轻薄柔韧，舒展灵活，穿戴者指尖呈现点点青绿，形似碧牙，镂刻掌上，又如远山含黛，云影参差。
Desc_375.ru: Тонкие и гибкие Перчатки украшены изумрудными и голубыми точками в форме клыков на кончиках пальцев, а также гравюрами на ладонях, которые издалека выглядят как зеленые горы, окутанные туманными облаками.

Desc_376.en: "Clouds hang low over distant peaks, snow dances through boundless sky." The clouds are low and far away, and the snow is dancing in the sky. The spotless white gloves are chilly to the touch, stirring up frosty wind as though snow were falling from the sky when waved around.
Desc_376.cn: “繁云低远岫，飞雪舞长空”。浑似雪质地洁白，触感冰凉，挥舞时寒风阵阵，似有雪降。

Desc_377.en: The extremely tensile gloves are aureate and white as though woven together from lavish gold and silver threads, emitting a pure and clear glow as brilliant as the sun and moon, as though soaring loongs were illuminating the celestial realm with the fire in their mouths.
Desc_377.cn: 金银织柔韧异常，黄白交织，宛如以金丝银线织就，影卧清光，昭乎日月，挥舞时如见矫龙衔烛，映照仙阙。

Desc_378.en: The gloves are told to possess the power of the god of supreme Yin, the master of ice and snow, and may even freeze one's vital organs until they shatter, but only the most experienced Qi Art users may make use of them.
Desc_378.cn: 玄冥乃太阴之神，司掌一切厉风冰雪。太阴玄冥手至阴至寒，有化水为冰、冻碎五脏之能，非内功深厚者不能执用。

Desc_379.en: The gloves have a unique and bewitching fragrance that ensnares those who smell it like a femme fatale until they lose their strength and even grasp of reality. People describe it as: "Fragrance rises, soul fades; scent scatters, life ends."
Desc_379.cn: 柔香蚀骨香气独特，终日旖旎，冰凉适意，嗅者骨酥，能令人醉生梦死，不省人事，时人谓曰：“香起魂消，香散人亡”。

Desc_380.en: The ingeniously woven dewcatchers are capable of collecting water droplets without them adhering to the surface, as they stay in the palms like dew on lotus leaves.
Desc_380.cn: 携露织工精巧，浑然天成，水覆于其上时凝而不漏，聚而不散，如颗颗露珠一般驻留于掌中，可谓携露带雪，变化无方。
Desc_380.ru: Искусно сплетенные влагоуловители способны собирать капли воды, не прилипая к поверхности, поскольку они остаются на ладонях, как роса на листьях лотоса.

Desc_381.en: Shaped like a pole weapon with a sharp prong and a lotus design in the middle, the vajra has no branch or extension, symbolizing the one all-encompassing law of the Buddha.
Desc_381.cn: 独钴铁杵似棍而头尖，杵腰有莲华纹，其形上下一体，不分旁支，象征佛陀以一法融摄诸法。
Desc_381.ru: По форме напоминающая древко Оружия с острым наконечником и рисунком лотоса посередине, Ваджра не имеет ответвлений или продолжений, символизируя единый всеобъемлющий закон Будды.

Desc_382.en: Forged from steel, the vajra is ordinary and unadorned with three prongs but tough enough to break bones and stones.
Desc_382.cn: 镔钢杵乃是由钢铁铸成，钴分三道，质地坚硬，虽浑无装饰，其貌不扬，却可碎骨裂石。
Desc_382.ru: Выкованная из стали, Ваджра обычная, без украшений, с тремя зубцами, но достаточно прочная, чтобы ломать кости и камни.

Desc_383.en: The vajra is uniquely shaped with two prongs that look like hooks, which symbolize stability and wisdom, as they free one from desires and worries. One may use it to hit the enemy or pierce them with the sharp hooks.
Desc_383.cn: 钩钳杵顶端开口，形制独特，钴分两道，形如钩钳，象征“定、慧”二法可使人摒弃欲念，破除烦恼，使用时既能以杵身撞击，也可以利钩伤人。

Desc_384.en: "The Three Realms are unsafe, like a burning house, plagued by suffering without end." It's told that mortals live in a world full of worries and are burning in agony. Carved with a flame design, the warm vajra may help one recall the suffering of mortals in a world of fury and flames.
Desc_384.cn: “三界无安，犹如火宅，常有生老病死忧患，如是等火，炽然不息”。火舍杵入手温热，杵身刻有烈焰，可令人忆起火宅煎熬之苦，归心向道。

Desc_385.en: Truly: 'The lion roars, mastering all virtues.' The majestic and mighty vajra has four prongs mounted with claws to symbolize the head of a lion; it sounds like the angry roar of a lion when tossed out, powerful enough to deter all beasts.
Desc_385.cn: 正所谓：“狮子奋迅，具足万行”。狮头宝杵光明炳耀，威风凛凛，四股外端各各有爪，象征狮头，掷出时声如狮王怒吼，可令百兽慑服。

Desc_386.en: It's golden in color and looks like a thousand-story pagoda. If the user concentrates and recites Buddhist scriptures, he can make it rotate rapidly. The pagodas on it will be opened story by story, emitting dazzling light, solemn and majestic, and astonishing in power.
Desc_386.cn: 千层塔色泽金黄，形若千层佛塔，使用者若凝神定气，默诵佛经，便可令其飞速旋转，其上佛塔层层洞开，光照大千，肃穆威严，声势惊人。

Desc_387.en: It is shaped like the great wheel of Maha Cakra Vajra with three prongs and flames that burn out any doubts. The three prongs upon it spin in circles like a wheel, capable of manifesting the true words of the Buddha and making one repent and submit to the will of the wielder.
Desc_387.cn: 大轮金刚杵乃是三钴金刚杵，形如大轮金刚明王所用法器，有断惑之智焰，清净圆满之功德。其上三钴盘转如轮，可于空中显现真言，使人憬然自悔，臣服跪拜。

Desc_388.en: "In the land of Nirriti, the Immovable Tathagata stands—fiery wrath upon solid rock." Legend says it that the vajra is as tough and unmovable as the merciful spirit of Acala; when thrown out, it moves like an unshakable flame that seems as though capable of annihilating everything and turning the world upside down.
Desc_388.cn: “依涅哩底方，不动如来使，威怒身猛焰，安住在盘石”。相传此杵有不动明王慈悲心之坚固，无可撼动；掷出时形如烈焰，似能翻天覆地、焚毁一切，故称“不动尊”。

Desc_389.en: It's told the vajra is a manifestation of Vairocana's meditative consciousness, invincible and unmovable. One will possess the great might of Vairocana, complete all good deeds, and spread the light of wisdom throughout the world of mortals.
Desc_389.cn: 相传大日如来杵乃法身佛之三昧耶形，无坚不摧，不可撼动，持者能得大日如来之伟力，发众生之善根，除有情之业障，令智慧之光遍照法界。

Desc_390.en: The copper vajra is a Buddhist artifact from Sindhu with a round cap and sharp tip. It is often held by Buddhist monks for training, but may also be used for defense.
Desc_390.cn: 元铜杵颜色暗黄，圆头而尖梢，乃是由天竺传入的佛门法器，僧人常持之以修行，亦可用以御敌。
Desc_390.ru: Медная Ваджра - буддийский артефакт из Синдху с круглой крышкой и острым наконечником. Он часто используется буддийскими монахами для тренировок, но также может использоваться для защиты.

Desc_391.en: Made up of a skeleton inlaid with gold and silver, the vajra looks menacing but also possesses great power. It is told to be created by an eminent monk to spread the knowledge of samsara, the cycle of death and rebirth.
Desc_391.cn: 骷髅杵乃是取髑髅镀以金银后制成，虽形貌可怖，却颇具威力，相传乃是昔日高僧为令世人见色相即空，悟生死轮回之道所创。

Desc_392.en: It is told that the Buddhist swastika symbol is on the chest of Tathagata, representing a myriad of prosperity and good luck. Such a symbol is also carved on the vajra, and whoever holds it may counter all difficulties with the power of faith.
Desc_392.cn: 传说如来胸前有万字印记，能汇聚万种吉祥、功德。万字杵杵身刻画万字，持此杵者可凭心中虔诚、宝杵威力，排除艰险，克服万难。

Desc_393.en: The heavy vajra is shaped like the artifact of the vajra warrior, who is told to be an unusually strong guardian of the Buddha. The vajra may destroy demons and repel outlaws.
Desc_393.cn: 力士杵质地沉重，因形如金刚力士所持法器而得名。相传金刚力士身负巨力，随侍佛前，此杵亦能摧毁魔敌，破除外道。
Desc_393.ru: Тяжелая Ваджра выполнена в форме артефакта воина Ваджры, который, как говорят, является необычайно сильным стражем Будды. Ваджра может уничтожать демонов и отпугивать преступников.

Desc_394.en: The vajra has five prongs that represent the five wisdoms and ten perfections, converging like the Buddhist light and freeing one from the ten great worries of the world.
Desc_394.cn: 五峰光明杵乃是五股宝杵，每股为一峰，象征五智；上下相合，象征十波罗蜜；五钴齐聚，有如佛慧，能破解十种烦恼，使人心得大光明。
Desc_394.ru: Ваджра имеет пять зубцов, которые символизируют пять мудростей и десять совершенств, сходящихся подобно буддийскому свету и освобождающих человека от десяти великих мирских забот.

Desc_395.en: Shaped like the Tiger Wisdom King's artifact, the vajra is decorated with a tigerskin design and ignites like the King's flame of wisdom when waved around. It may illuminate the world and suppress outlaws with its great might and the mercy of the Bodhisattva.
Desc_395.cn: 虎衣宝杵形似虎衣明王所用之杵，其上纹路有如虎斑，挥动时光焰自起，如同明王智火，能以自性之威、菩萨之慈降伏外道，光照众生。

Desc_396.en: Legend says that the Infallible Wisdom King, Aparajita, is "invincible against evil while holding only a one-pronged vajra." Made of refined iron, the one-pronged aureate vajra is extremely heavy that only one with the strength of a Wisdom King may be able to hold it.
Desc_396.cn: 传说无能胜明王“以明咒降服魔军，退治障碍之尊，不可战胜，持独钴杵”。无能胜乃是以精铁制成的独钴杵，其上金光熠熠，力重千钧，持者似有明王之能，故而得名。

Desc_397.en: "Power to subdue evil is called Great Might; protection of virtue is called Great Virtue." Shaped like a trident, the vajra is carved with a design of Yamantaka, the destroyer of death, who is capable of subduing evil and sins while bringing fortune and prosperity with his flame of wisdom.
Desc_397.cn: “有伏恶之势，谓之大威；有护善之功，谓之大德”。此杵形如三叉宝戟，上刻大威德明王像，能以慧焰破除一切罪障，增长福德，故以威德名之。

Desc_398.en: Asura is a vengeful and arrogant being between god, human and demon, who has a celestial's power but not the morality. The vajra is pure and white on one end like gods; dark and sinister like demons on the other end; the middle is in a state of chaos like humans. With it, one may possess the might of Asura and become invincible across the six paths.
Desc_398.cn: 非天即阿修罗，易怒好斗，骄矜自恃，介于神、人、鬼之间，有天人之福而无天人之德，故而得名。非天一端光明，似神；一端青黑，象鬼；中段混沌，如人；持者可借阿修罗之威，睥睨众生，六道难敌。

Desc_399.en: The vajra looks as though charred with a warm sheen. It is often used for pestle arts practice since it doesn't possess enough power for real combat despite the intact form.
Desc_399.cn: 灶黑短杵色如灶灰，光泽温润，形虽完备，却无神威，常用于杵法的练习。
Desc_399.ru: Ваджра выглядит так, как будто обуглена, с теплым блеском. Его часто используют для занятий боевыми искусствами с пестиком, поскольку, несмотря на неповрежденную форму, он не обладает достаточной силой для реального боя.

Desc_400.en: The jadestone vajra has three prongs that represent the three expositions of the dharma. Whoever holds it may become enlightened and no longer troubled by evil ghosts.
Desc_400.cn: 三钴石杵乃是以玉石制成，杵头分三枝，分表三智三观等三轨之法门，行者手执此杵，则神智清明，不为恶鬼所难。
Desc_400.ru: Ваджра из жадеитового камня имеет три зубца, которые представляют три изложения дхармы. Тот, кто владеет им, может стать просветленным и его больше не будут беспокоить злые духи.

Desc_401.en: The vajra is green and red striped with a faint ghostly air, which grants the wielder immense strength of the strong and agile yaksha spirit.
Desc_401.cn: 夜叉即捷疾鬼，其力过人，轻捷勇健。夜叉杵青红交织，隐有鬼气，持者只觉气力大盛，如有夜叉相助。
Desc_401.ru: Ваджра в зеленую и красную полоску со слабым призрачным налетом, который наделяет владельца огромной Силой сильного и подвижного Духа якши.

Desc_402.en: Legend tells that Skanda, the wise bodhisattva that protects the Buddhist teachings, holds a sword-like vajra capable of slaying demons. This one-pronged jade vajra emits a piercing, divine sound that may repel all evil when waved around.
Desc_402.cn: 相传韦陀菩萨乃智慧护法之神，手中金刚杵形如宝剑，能斩妖魔。韦驮杵乃独钴玉杵，舞动时声声破空，如闻梵音，可使妖邪退避。

Desc_403.en: The clear and unadorned vajra seems to encompass all forms and yet possesses no set form, containing arcane mysterious and incredible might.
Desc_403.cn: 无相杵质地通透，浑无装饰，如蕴众相于一相，如离诸相而无相，玄妙幽远，威能内蕴，故称“无相”。
Desc_403.ru: Ясная и ничем не украшенная Ваджра, кажется, охватывает все формы и все же не обладает определенной формой, заключая в себе тайную таинственность и невероятную мощь.

Desc_404.en: Made from rare jade, the vajra has ever-changing colors with a twinkling blue tip; it is not only powerful enough to destroy enemies but also dazzlingly brilliant.
Desc_404.cn: 五色蓝芒杵乃是以美玉制成，杵身颜色变幻，五色俱全；尖端隐透蓝芒，闪烁不定；既有破敌之威能，亦有炫目之光辉，因而得名。
Desc_404.ru: Изготовленная из редкого Нефрита, Ваджра имеет постоянно меняющийся цвет с мерцающим синим наконечником; она не только достаточно мощная, чтобы уничтожать врагов, но и ослепительно блестящая.

Desc_405.en: Legend tells of Mt. Sumeru made up of gold, silver, colored glass and crystal in the center of the thirty-three heavens. The vajra is mounted with the four treasures, glowing a divine light that deters demons and spirits as though Mt. Sumeru were collapsing.
Desc_405.cn: 传说须弥山由金、银、琉璃、水晶四宝组成，居三十三天中央。四宝须弥杵四宝齐聚，华光自生，掷出时如须弥山倾，咸海水覆，可令妖魔胆裂，鬼神心惊。

Desc_406.en: Adorned with jade, the iron vajra is extremely tough and unbreakable, capable of destroying all ignorance, pain, hindrance and decline like the heart of Tathagata.
Desc_406.cn: 金刚摧破以铁为身，以玉为饰，坚硬无比，不可摧折，能同如来金刚心一般断绝一切愚顽、痛苦、障碍、衰败，因此得名。
Desc_406.ru: Украшенная Нефритом, железная Ваджра чрезвычайно прочна и нерушима, способна уничтожить все невежество, боль, препятствия и упадок, подобно сердцу Татхагаты.

Desc_407.en: "Qingdu, Ziwei, Grand Music of Juntian—where the Emperor dwells." The vajra shines a divine light as though in the heavenly realm of gods, while emitting a sound like the melodious celestial music when waved against the wind, with an all-conquering force that petrifies the bodhisattvas and gods when thrown out.
Desc_407.cn: “清都紫微、钧天广乐，帝之所居”。钧天柱仙光熠熠，如临上帝之钧天；破风有声，如闻百神之广乐；掷出时势如天崩，神佛惊惧。

Desc_408.en: The jadestone pestle is said to be used by a student in the Tang Dynasty to grind celestial herbs for a blessed romantic relationship, so it may also be seen as a token of love.
Desc_408.cn: 捣药棒以玉石制成，形如药杵，相传唐时一书生曾以此物捣取灵药，求得佳人归，故而亦可以之定情。
Desc_408.ru: Говорят, что пестик из жадеита использовался учеником династии Тан для измельчения небесных Трав для благословенных романтических отношений, поэтому его также можно рассматривать как знак любви.

Desc_409.en: "The moonlight reflects on the treasure, and its crystal-like light is dazzling." Mounted with stunning jadestones, the iron vajra has a brilliance like the moon and stars that symbolizes the wielder's infinite and enlightening wisdom.
Desc_409.cn: “月与宝相射，晶光争鲜妍”。晶光杵乃是以美玉嵌于铁杵上而成，光似星月，象征持者灵台清明，智如光耀。

Desc_410.en: The jade vajra is exquisitely adorned in the shape of Guhyapada's artifact without any prongs on either end, capable of enlightening the wielder and annihilating evil.
Desc_410.cn: 独钴玉骨杵以玉为骨，装饰精美，两头皆不分叉，形同密迹金刚所持之法器，可启发佛心，摧毁外敌。
Desc_410.ru: Ваджра из Нефрита изысканно украшена в форме артефакта Гухьяпады без каких-либо зубцов на обоих концах, способного просветлять владельца и уничтожать зло.

Desc_411.en: The blade-like vajra is a dazzling and solemn artifact carved with the changing looks of the Buddha. It produces a constant wind sound when waved around, capable of destroying all obstacles and suppressing evil.
Desc_411.cn: 降魔杵形如利刃，光芒耀眼，杵腰刻有佛之笑、怒、骂三相，清净庄严，舞动时风声不住，能散坏诸障，降伏魔怨。

Desc_412.en: The Ultimate Truth permanently stays true no matter the circumstances, much like the vajra that remains strong and resilient even though seasons change and time flies.
Desc_412.cn: 真实如常者，即是真如，谓真实于一切法，常如其性。真如杵质地坚固，其性不分寒暑冬夏、沧海桑田，皆始终如一，故而得名。
Desc_412.ru: Высшая истина неизменно остается верной независимо от обстоятельств, подобно Ваджре, которая остается сильной и устойчивой, несмотря на смену времен года и бег времени.

Desc_413.en: The vajra is decorated with the seven relics of the Pure Land that gleam and chime clearly, appearing heavenly from afar and capable of freeing one from worries and evil spirits.
Desc_413.cn: 佛说极乐净土之中，七宝覆地。七宝坠玉杵以七种宝物为饰，其声琳琅，光华灵动，望之犹如净土，可消持者烦恼，使邪祟远避。
Desc_413.ru: Ваджра украшена семью реликвиями Чистой Земли, которые ярко сияют и перезванивают, издалека кажутся небесными и способны освободить человека от забот и злых Духов.

Desc_414.en: Legend says it that Padanaksipa, the Wrathful Wisdom King, holds a spinning wheel on the left and a vajra on the right. The Padanaksipa's Vajra is mounted with a wheel that seems to be burning in the King's eternal flame of wisdom, capable of eliminating all evil and sins.
Desc_414.cn: 传说步掷金刚右手持旋盖，左手握金刚杵，有无上智德。步掷旋盖虽为玉杵，杵端却如伞盖，内中似有无尽火焰燃烧，如明王智火一般，能除一切业障。

Desc_415.en: "Just as among all deities of the Desire Realm, Mara Papīyan reigns supreme." The vajra is told to be created by demon king Mara to mock the celestial gods. Except for the tip in the center, it has eight prongs that rebel against the eight righteous paths of Buddhism; together, the prongs may destroy one's body and spirit and condemn them with eternal pain.
Desc_415.cn: “譬如欲界诸神力，天魔波旬为第一”。相传九钴天魔杵乃是魔王波旬为表蔑视天神而创，除中轴外共有八钴，意指反对八正道；八钴并行，便能使人形神俱灭，永堕苦海。

Desc_416.en: The three realms encompass the cycle of life and death. Legend says it that Trailokyavijaya uses the indestructible vajra which shines like a burning flame that may liberate one from the poison of greed, insanity and obsession, leaving no filth in the three realms.
Desc_416.cn: 三界即“欲界、色界、无色界”，乃一切有情生死轮回之所。相传三界降服乃降三世明王所用，其质坚固不坏，佛光如火，能破除贪嗔痴三毒，烧尽无始以来无明之积薪，使世无遗垢，故而得名。

Desc_417.en: The vajra has three equally-long prongs that symbolize the unity of the body, mouth and will. It is tough enough to be wielded to destroy all troubles and eliminate enemies.
Desc_417.cn: 三钴木杵之三钴长短一致，寓意“身、口、意”三密平等，其质坚硬，持者可以之摧毁烦恼，消灭外敌。
