Desc_852.en: Plain and light, this celestial weapon is made of a strange iron 'Cicadium' that only grows one cun in a thousand years.\nThis celestial sword is dark and rusty, and when it is swung, it sprays poisonous gas, as if it had been immersed in the poison pool for a long time.
Desc_852.cn: 造型朴素、质地轻盈的神兵，以千年才长一寸的奇铁“蝉壳子”所铸。\n此神兵秽暗无光、锈迹斑斑，挥动时毒气四溢，仿佛浸泡于毒池之中已年深日久。

Desc_853.en: The broad and heavy sword is made of the 'Spirit Seal Stone,' which is formed by the bones of Dayue Yaochang who has ascended to immortality.\nAlthough it is blunt and has no sharp edge, this celestial sword is heavy and powerful, and ghosts scatter where the sword points.
Desc_853.cn: 形宽体正、质地沉重的神兵，以大岳瑶常羽化后的尸骨凝聚而成的“镇狱伏邪石”所铸。\n此神兵虽然钝拙无锋，但势沉力猛，剑风所指，鬼怪无不披靡。

Desc_854.en: The celestial weapon shaped strangely like an ice pick is made of 'Permafrost Essence' that does not melt even in the True Fire of Ultimate Yang on Mt. Jiu Han.\nThis celestial weapon sometimes turns into ice, sometimes turns into water, and its shape changes as the user pleases.
Desc_854.cn: 造型怪异、如同冰锥的神兵，以九寒山下不惧太阳真火的“玄冰精魄”所制。\n此神兵时而成冰，时而化水，奇形百状，形态随心所欲，变化无常。

Desc_855.en: The gorgeously shaped, five-colored celestial weapon is forged from the 'golden cocoon' that can be restored to its original state when it is shone upon no matter how damaged it is.\nThis celestial sword can be transformed into countless threads, turning into a golden claw that creates blazing heat waves.
Desc_855.cn: 造型华丽、五色并现的神兵，以无论受到何等损伤，一遇明光便可复原如初的“金茧”炼化而成。\n此神兵可变作千丝万缕，化为金红弯爪，引剔骨热浪。

Desc_856.en: The celestial weapon that is attached to the palm appears ablaze, as it is formed from the 'breathing fire' on Mt. Godash in Qingqiu.\nThis celestial weapon is a flame shaped like a spiritual fox, wrapped around the user's hand. The more the spiritual fire flourishes, the more withered the hand.
Desc_856.cn: 附于手掌、状若流火的神兵，以青丘焚神山上所生的“活火种”炼化而成。\n此神兵望之犹如一团形如灵狐的火焰，裹绕于人手，灵火越盛，人手却愈显憔悴。

Desc_857.en: The celestial weapon with the shape of a loong's tail and made of neither metal nor stone is transformed from the broken tail of the god of Mt. Zhong, 'Candelor,' by condensing the soul of a hundred loongs.\nThis celestial weapon has a mind of its own, understands human language, and may relieve people's worries and calm their minds.
Desc_857.cn: 状如龙尾、非铁非石的神兵，以钟山之神“烛阴”的断尾凝聚百龙之魂变化而成。\n此神兵能识人语，能通人意，可为人消愁解惑，安定心神。

Desc_858.en: The invisible weapon with blood and soul is transformed from the 'living jade' that is nourished by the three elements of Jianmu tree, Xirang earth, and human soul.\nThis celestial weapon changes its nature and performs good deeds and misdeeds for no particular reason.
Desc_858.cn: 视不可见、有血有灵的神兵，以受建木、息壤、人灵三者供养而生的“活玉”变化而成。\n此神兵时善时恶，不知其恶之所向，不知其善之所来，无原亦无咎。

Desc_859.en: The terrifying and ferocious celestial weapon is made of the Blood Maple stained with Chi You's blood.\nThis celestial weapon is strong when it tastes blood, and the harder it fights, the more powerful it becomes. Every swipe comes with falling blood and the roar of an army.
Desc_859.cn: 造型骇人、凶戾可怖的神兵，以沾染了蚩尤鲜血而生的“血枫木”打造而成。\n此神兵见血则强，愈是奋战，威力愈显，每一挥击，便可见血雨坠地，闻万军咆哮。

Desc_860.en: Shaped like a token, the celestial weapon, which is sometimes dark and sometimes bright, is formed from the fusion of Yin and Yang on the Kunlun Mountains, and then imbued with an unnamed divine power.\nThere is a mystic world within this celestial weapon, where three thousand mountains, four poles and four seas lie.
Desc_860.cn: 形如令牌、时晦时明的神兵，以合虚之神融合阴阳二气得形于昆仑山，后又注入了一股无名神力而成。\n此神兵内有乾坤，收有三千大山，四极四海。

Desc_861.en: A sword made of an unknown material that is neither gold nor iron, with the word 'Fuyu' inscribed on it in an archaic style.\nThis sword has been corrupted by evil, and it is surrounded by a dark aura, and when it is swung, it makes the sound of demons howling.
Desc_861.cn: 造型古朴、非金非铁的长剑，因在剑柄的两面以篆体刻着“伏”、“虞”二字，故而以伏虞为名。\n此剑受邪力侵染，剑身黑气奔腾，挥舞时似有百鬼呼啸，群妖悲鸣。

Desc_862.en: Shaped like a delicate flower and transformed from Emperor's Bellflower, this celestial weapon may appear weak but is actually sharp and powerful.\nThis celestial weapon is colorful and charming. When it is wielded, it is like a red cloud falling to the ground and valleys of flowers blooming.
Desc_862.cn: 外柔内刚、形如娇花的神兵，由帝昭语茯花化形而成。\n此神兵鲜红夺目，瑰丽万方，舞动之时，如天边红云坠落地上，好似百花怒放。

Desc_863.en: Born in nature and shaped like a bamboo branch, this celestial weapon is formed by the spirit of the purple bamboo.\nThis celestial weapon understands human emotion, can mourn the sorrow, rejoice the joy, and cherish the righteousness.
Desc_863.cn: 发于自然、形如竹枝的神兵，由紫竹之灵化形而成。\n此神兵能见尘世，能解人心，能悲事间万物之悲，能喜世间万物之喜，重情知义，蕙质兰心。

Desc_864.en: Plain and light, this celestial weapon is made of a strange iron 'Cicadium' that only grows one cun in a thousand years.\nThis celestial sword emits a bright silver light, and when swung it makes a pleasant sound, drawing over birds from forests which linger around.
Desc_864.cn: 造型朴素、质地轻盈的神兵，以千年才长一寸的奇铁“蝉壳子”所铸。\n此神兵清淑皎洁、澄澈碧然，挥动时泠泠作响，能引来山林中的鸟雀盘桓不去。

Desc_865.en: The broad and heavy sword is made of the 'Spirit Seal Stone,' which is formed by the bones of Dayue Yaochang who has ascended to immortality.\nThis celestial sword is edgeless yet as heavy as a mountain and as unstoppable as thunder; all beasts and demons flee in the face of it.
Desc_865.cn: 形宽体正、质地沉重的神兵，以大岳瑶常羽化后的尸骨凝聚而成的“镇狱伏邪石”所铸。\n此神兵无锋无刃，但如山似岳，风雷难撼，妖鬼禽兽闻之无不惊逃。

Desc_866.en: The celestial weapon shaped strangely like an ice pick is made of 'Permafrost Essence' that does not melt even in the True Fire of Ultimate Yang on Mt. Jiu Han.\nThis celestial weapon is formed from ice and can be used as a musical instrument. If a sad song is played, a hoarfrost of sorrow forms wherever the music reaches.
Desc_866.cn: 造型怪异、如同冰锥的神兵，以九寒山下不惧太阳真火的“玄冰精魄”所制。\n此神兵凝冰成形，可作乐器，若奏悲歌，则其声所至，无不降霜飞雪，万物哀怨。

Desc_867.en: The gorgeously shaped, five-colored celestial weapon is forged from the 'golden cocoon' that can be restored to its original state when it is shone upon no matter how damaged it is.\nThis celestial weapon can be spread out like the wings of a fenghuang, enabling the user to ride light and travel thousands of li in an instant.
Desc_867.cn: 造型华丽、五色并现的神兵，以无论受到何等损伤，一遇明光便可复原如初的“金茧”炼化而成。\n此神兵可如凤凰羽翼展开，能乘光而飞，瞬息千里。

Desc_868.en: The celestial weapon that is attached to the palm appears ablaze, as it is formed from the 'breathing fire' on Mt. Godash in Qingqiu.\nThis celestial weapon is invisible and intangible, but it emits a blazing fire in the piercing sound of crying, and everyone who hears it can't help but feel a deep sense of sorrow.
Desc_868.cn: 附于手掌、状若流火的神兵，以青丘焚神山上所生的“活火种”炼化而成。\n此神兵无形无质，却可在一片刺耳的焚烧声中发出冲天火光，见之愁苦，闻之欲绝。

Desc_869.en: The celestial weapon with the shape of a loong's tail and made of neither metal nor stone is transformed from the broken tail of the god of Mt. Zhong, 'Candelor,' by condensing the soul of a hundred loongs.\nThis celestial weapon is as humble as dead wood, but it contains the wisdom of no desire, and those who hold it will not be troubled by life and death.
Desc_869.cn: 状如龙尾、非铁非石的神兵，以钟山之神“烛阴”的断尾凝聚百龙之魂变化而成。\n此神兵光芒不显，好似枯木，但和光同尘，无生无灭，持之生死无惧。

Desc_870.en: The invisible weapon with blood and soul is transformed from the 'living jade' that is nourished by the three elements of Jianmu tree, Xirang earth, and human soul.\nThis celestial weapon moves around elusively with no trace left behind. It looks harmless but is actually extremely sharp and may kill in the blink of an eye.
Desc_870.cn: 视不可见、有血有灵的神兵，以受建木、息壤、人灵三者供养而生的“活玉”变化而成。\n此神兵时有时无，鬼没神出，看似无害，实则锋利无匹，见血夺命。

Desc_871.en: The terrifying and ferocious celestial weapon is made of the Blood Maple stained with Chi You's blood.\nThis celestial weapon has experienced thousands of fierce battles, and its desire to fight has never diminished. If it does not slaughter lives, it will lose its edge.
Desc_871.cn: 造型骇人、凶戾可怖的神兵，以沾染了蚩尤鲜血而生的“血枫木”打造而成。\n此神兵经历千百恶战，战意从无消减，若不杀生害命，反失光芒。

Desc_872.en: Shaped like a token, the celestial weapon, which is sometimes dark and sometimes bright, is formed from the fusion of Yin and Yang on the Kunlun Mountains, and then imbued with an unnamed divine power.\nThere is a mystic world within this celestial weapon, where three thousand clouds and five thunders of righteousness lie.
Desc_872.cn: 形如令牌、时晦时明的神兵，以合虚之神融合阴阳二气得形于昆仑山，后又注入了一股无名神力而成。\n此神兵内有乾坤，收有三千云霞，正法五雷。

Desc_873.en: A sword made of an unknown material that is neither gold nor iron, with the word 'Fuyu' inscribed on it in an archaic style.\nThis sword has been corrupted by evil and flickers as though beings of light and dark echoed each other with the pure Qi of the heavens and the dark Qi of the earth.
Desc_873.cn: 造型古朴、非金非铁的长剑，因在剑柄的两面以篆体刻着“伏”、“虞”二字，故而以伏虞为名。\n此剑受邪力侵染，剑刃明灭不定，似有一白一玄二物，引天之清气、地之幽冥相互交征。

Desc_874.en: Shaped like a delicate flower and transformed from Emperor's Bellflower, this celestial weapon may appear weak but is actually sharp and powerful.\nThis celestial weapon is dazzling shining, and with just one move, the sword emits a sunglow, which is incomparable with all the light in the world.
Desc_874.cn: 外柔内刚、形如娇花的神兵，由帝昭语茯花化形而成。\n此神兵光芒夺目，照耀四野，微微意动，便可见赤霞经天，乱红迤地，非世间一切芳华可比。

Desc_875.en: Born in nature and shaped like a bamboo branch, this celestial weapon is formed by the spirit of the purple bamboo.\nThis celestial weapon attained both a spirit and emotion after over a thousand years of cultivation and eventually grew a soul.
Desc_875.cn: 发于自然、形如竹枝的神兵，由紫竹之灵化形而成。\n此神兵九百年化灵于天地，四百九十年生慧于凡尘，因生而有情，又八十一年因情获命，脱胎换骨。

Desc_876.en: It lives! The jade lives! Took my life in the past, and slew my enemy today.
Desc_876.cn: 玉活……玉活……昔日夺我之命，今日灭我之敌……
Desc_876.ru: Оно живет! Нефрит жив! Отнял у меня жизнь в прошлом и убил моего врага сегодня.

Desc_877.en: The divine iron of no name; With doubts disaster came; With the return of the sword, no filth makes claim.
Desc_877.cn: 神铁不能名，相疑祸自行，神女还剑来，污衣亦冰清……
Desc_877.ru: Божественное железо без имени; С сомнениями пришла катастрофа; С возвращением Меча никакая грязь не претендует.

Desc_878.en: Heavy sword without edge... it was in vain in the end.
Desc_878.ru: Тяжелый Меч без острия... в конце концов, все было напрасно.

Desc_879.en: The world's greatest disaster saved the world, the world's greatest blessing is prisoned by the world.
Desc_879.cn: 天下至祸救天下人，天下至福为天下囚……
Desc_879.ru: Величайшая в мире катастрофа спасла мир, величайшее в мире благословение находится в плену у мира.

Desc_880.en: The evil craves fame, the fool seeks in vain and the loyal lies slain.
Desc_880.cn: 魔贪万世功，痴人求未果，情深自成嗔……
Desc_880.ru: Зло жаждет славы, глупец ищет напрасно, а верный лежит убитый.

Desc_881.en: Nothing to repay but my life.
Desc_881.cn: 十世千年，何以为报……无以为报，死而为报……
Desc_881.ru: Мне нечем отплатить, кроме своей жизни.

Desc_882.en: The Veil that Shrouds Heaven... The Curtain that Conceals Hearts...
Desc_882.ru: Завеса, которая окутывает Небеса... Занавес, скрывающий сердца...

Desc_883.en: "The Enlightened Heavenly Beast, born of pure metal essence; tiger-bodied, marked with dark patterns, human-faced with nine heads. Such is its mighty form. Its gaze falls upon Kun Mountain, striking awe into all living spirits."
Desc_883.cn: “开明天兽，禀兹金精，虎身玄纹，人面九首，表此桀形，瞪眎昆山，威慑百灵。”

Desc_935.en: An earthly immortal's possession and companion alike, born from a thousand-year spirit essence within the earth veins—a living being...
Desc_935.cn: 地仙之物，亦是地仙之友，乃地脉中千年精魂所化，乃有生之物……
Desc_935.ru: Обладатель и спутник земного Бессмертного, рожденный из тысячелетней сущности Духа в земных венах — живое существо...

Desc_936.en: The Thousand Delusions of the Eight Desires lie within these claws!
Desc_936.ru: Тысяча заблуждений Восьми Желаний заключены в этих когтях!

Desc_937.en: Ten Thousand Ages and Ten Thousand Arts may be annihilated!
Desc_937.ru: Десять тысяч эпох и десять тысяч искусств могут быть уничтожены!

Desc_938.en: The myriad forms of the Profane Demon are all reflected within this eye!
Desc_938.ru: Мириады форм Нечестивого Демона отражаются в этом глазу!

Desc_884.en: A voice coming through the larynx from Dantian.
Desc_884.cn: 以丹田之气，发喉嗓之声。

Desc_921.en: Teeth wrought from will and soul, shifting between substance and void, keen beyond measure, as though never wholly real.
Desc_921.cn: 由心念与元魄凝成的细密利齿，虚实不定，锐不可当，不似切实存在之物。
Desc_921.ru: Зубы, выкованные из воли и души, перемещающиеся между материей и пустотой, сверх меры острые, как будто никогда не были полностью реальными.

Desc_922.en: Claws formed of will and soul, drifting and insubstantial yet razor-sharp, as though they only half exist.
Desc_922.cn: 由心念与元魄凝成的空无利爪，飘渺不定，锋芒毕露，不似切实存在之物。
Desc_922.ru: Когти, созданные из воли и души, дрейфующие и нематериальные, но в то же время острые как бритва, как будто они существуют только наполовину.

Desc_923.en: A phantom tail born of will and soul, elusive and fierce, coiled with strength, as though it belongs more to illusion than to flesh.
Desc_923.cn: 由心念与元魄凝成的虚幻长尾，玄虚不定，遒劲刚猛，不似切实存在之物。
Desc_923.ru: Призрачный хвост, рожденный волей и душой, неуловимый и свирепый, обвитый Силой, как будто он больше принадлежит иллюзии, чем плоти.

Desc_890.en: Sharp claw of a Divine Loong.

Desc_893.en: Sharp claw of a Black Loong.

Desc_895.en: Sharp claw of a Red Loong.

Desc_912.en: Stele borne by the Ba Xia.

Desc_914.en: Sharp claw of the Bi An.

Desc_915.en: Long whiskers of the Fu Xi.

Desc_917.en: Water-holding pearl of the Chi Wen.

Desc_920.en: Sharp Claw of the Suan Ni.
